31262.s: The bill amends the Warenwet to allow the minister to impose orders backed by administrative enforcement (bestuursdwang) for serious norm violations in the interest of public health and safety, and to make several related changes. It removes the blanket delegation in article 1(5), shifts the power to reject products to the minister, and alters the Wet op de economische delicten.
31262.j: The memorandum justifies immediate enforcement powers by the need to act quickly against repeat offenders where prosecution is too slow, subject to proportionality and subsidiarity and later judicial review.
q: By giving the minister the power to apply administrative enforcement, action can be taken immediately when the situation warrants it.
Door de minister de bevoegdheid toe te kennen bestuursdwang toe te passen, kan indien de situatie daar aanleiding toe geeft, ogenblikkelijk worden opgetreden.
d: declaring rules under the Warenwet inapplicable by general administrative order (to be replaced by a treaty-based version)
minister orders a trader to halt sale or recall dangerous goods
minister orders repair or treatment of technical products and withdraws approval certificates
minister places technical products out of use for danger or procedure non-compliance
p: Gives the minister power to impose administrative enforcement orders immediately, shifting enforcement from prior prosecutorial review to after-the-fact judicial review by appeal.
Moves rejection of technical products from the inspector to the minister, with legal effect arising from the decision itself rather than the mark.
Allows the minister to take products out of use on danger grounds, backed by criminal offence for use.

parties: Supports stronger enforcement against repeat offenders but asks the government to guarantee bestuursdwang is not used too readily and to consider adding EU regulations to the annex for transparency.
Can the government guarantee that the instrument of bestuursdwang will not be resorted to too easily?
Kan de regering garanderen dat niet te gemakkelijk naar het instrument van de bestuursdwang wordt gegrepen?

Broadly agrees with the changes but worries about adequate appeal for entrepreneurs facing closure, the extra burden on courts from ex-post review, and the removal of inspectors' power to declare products unusable directly.
These members also consider it important that the entrepreneur receives sufficient means to object to a decision.
Deze leden vinden het daarnaast van belang dat de ondernemer voldoende middelen krijgt om bezwaar te maken tegen een beschikking.
Asks for more background data on repeat-offender firms and whether bestuursdwang should apply only after recidivism, seeking more information rather than taking a position.
They are of the view that there must first be a possibility for improvement and consider that this measure may only be imposed in case of recidivism.
Zij zijn namelijk van mening dat er eerst de mogelijkheid tot verbetering moet zijn en vinden dat deze maatregel alleen opgelegd mag worden bij recidive.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a bill extending administrative enforcement (bestuursdwang) under the Warenwet to the whole Act and to EU regulations enforced under it, recommending that the applicable EU regulations be listed in an annex for legal certainty. The minister's reply reports that the advice was followed by specifying in the statute that the rules must be set pursuant to an EU regulation whose violation is prohibited under the Warenwet, and that the editorial remarks were taken into account.
concerns: A general statutory basis for enforcing EU regulations by administrative enforcement is contrary to the principle of knowability of legislation, and the Raad recommended listing the relevant EU regulations in an annex to the bill.
The Raad asked that the explanatory memorandum clarify that information requests under article 5:20 Awb relate only to supervision of compliance with the Warenwet.
Several editorial remarks on wording, cross-references and consistency of the bill were made and taken into account.

31334.s: The bill amends Book 2 of the Dutch Civil Code to implement EU Directive 2007/63/EC on the mandatory independent expert report for mergers and demergers of public limited companies. It allows the expert report requirements for mergers (art. 2:328) and demergers (art. 2:334aa, 2:334cc) to be waived when all shareholders of the parties consent.
31334.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the waiver as a consent-based option mirroring the cross-border merger bill, without new executive delegation.
q: The first sentence of paragraph 1 and paragraph 2 do not apply if the shareholders of the merging companies consent.
De eerste volzin van lid 1 en lid 2 blijven buiten toepassing indien de aandeelhouders van de fuserende vennootschappen daarmee instemmen.

parties: Asks whether the accountant's review of the merger proposal can disappear and how small shareholders will obtain information on the exchange ratio if that oversight is removed.
Now that the accountant's controlling task may disappear, the CDA members ask how shareholders can obtain information about the exchange ratio.
Nu mogelijk de controlerende taak van de accountant kan verdwijnen vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie hoe aandeelhouders dan aan informatie betreffende de ruilverhouding kunnen komen.
Questions whether the cost savings justify the measure and what added value the directive has beyond reducing burdens, given the large discrepancy in cost estimates.
Furthermore, they ask whether this directive has substantial added value for Dutch NVs and BVs in reducing burdens.
Voorts vragen zij of deze richtlijn voor de Nederlandse NV's en BV's een substantiële toegevoegde waarde heeft om de lasten te verminderen.
Fears that dispensing with the accountant's review opens the door to fraud constructions and asks the government to investigate this, which the explanatory memorandum ignored.
These members ask whether this does not open the door to all kinds of fraud constructions.
Deze leden vragen of dit niet de deur openzet naar allerlei fraudeconstructies.

Supports reducing administrative burdens but asks about the relationship between the BW articles requiring a single or separate expert and whether shareholder consent could allow one joint expert, plus why Dutch law did not use the directive's option to drop the accountant statement.
What considerations underlie this, ask these members.
Welke afwegingen liggen hieraan ten grondslag, zo vragen deze leden.

31361.s: The bill approves a ministerial regulation of 23 November 2007 that suspended, for the rest of 2007, the Vamil environmental investment deduction, the energy investment deduction and the environmental investment deduction 2, which are budget-capped schemes. It sets the approval law to enter into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad.
31361.j: The memorandum justifies the suspension as necessary to prevent budget overruns in these budgeted schemes, and states the government intends to submit a proposal to the Staten-Generaal.
q: To prevent budget overrun, article 3.52, first paragraph, of the Income Tax Act 2001 provides the possibility to suspend these schemes.
Om budgetoverschrijding te voorkomen is in artikel 3.52, eerste lid, van de Wet inkomstenbelasting 2001 voorzien in de mogelijkheid deze regelingen buiten toepassing te stellen.
d: suspension of budget-capped investment deduction schemes
p: Parliament must approve the ministerial regulation that suspended the investment schemes, which gives it a retrospective check on the executive's use of the statutory suspension power.

parties: Asks the government to avoid repeated abrupt stoppages and wants to know how the State Secretary will improve parliament's involvement in changes to the schemes.
The CDA members are very curious about the State Secretary of Finance's proposals to improve the involvement of the House.
De leden van de CDA-fractie zijn erg benieuwd naar de voorstellen van de staatssecretaris van Financiën om de betrokkenheid van de Kamer te verbeteren.
Asks for the status of the promised improved procedure so that parliament is asked for approval about changes to the schemes only after the budget year.

The PvdA members are also curious about the change announced by the State Secretary of Finance regarding the procedure under which the House is asked for approval of changes only after the budget year has ended.

Ook zijn de leden van de PvdA-fractie benieuwd naar de door de staatssecretaris van Financiën aangekondigde verandering met betrekking tot de procedure dat de Tweede Kamer pas na afloop van het begrotingsjaar om toestemming wordt gevraagd over veranderingen.
Asks that planned changes to the schemes be sent to parliament in time so it can express its view on their content, referring to an adopted motion.
they request the government to include in the proposal for an improved approval procedure that planned changes to the schemes are also sent to the House in time in the future.

verzoeken zij de regering in het voorstel voor een verbeterde goedkeuringswetprocedure op te nemen dat voorgenomen wijzigingen van de regelingen, ook in de toekomst tijdig aan de Kamer worden toegestuurd.
Asks whether the budget overrun is structural and what the government will conclude, and asks about rejected applications and whether applicants were informed.
Does the government recognise this and what conclusions does it draw from it?
Onderkent de regering dit en welke conclusies verbindt zij hieraan?

31433.s: The bill amends the Soil Protection Act to add soil remediation funds to the national area investment budget, removing the stand-alone article 75a and allowing applications without a programme. It also gives the Minister power to set transitional rules on the shift of funds, including by ministerial regulation as a temporary measure pending a general administrative order.
31433.j: The memorandum justifies the transitional powers by the complexity of moving from the current financing system to the WILG, noting that the power to act by ministerial regulation is needed where an amvb cannot be awaited and that use is expected to be rare.
q: Because the transition from the current Wbb financing system to the WILG may involve complex cases requiring further elaboration of the transitional provisions, the Minister is given power to set procedural or administrative rules.

Doordat zich bij de overgang van de huidige financieringssystematiek van de Wbb naar de WILG een ingewikkelde casuïstiek kan voordoen, waarbij een nadere uitwerking van de in het wetsvoorstel opgenomen overgangsbepalingen noodzakelijk is
d: Artikel I, onderdeel B (art. 76c, tweede lid)
rules for applications without a programme
Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 77a, derde lid)
procedural and administrative transitional rules on fund transfer
Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 77a, vierde lid)
Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 77a, vijfde lid)
interim substantive transitional rules pending an amvb
p: Artikel I, onderdeel B (art. 76c, tweede lid)
The Minister may decide that no programme is needed and waive the prior-application requirement, with details left to a general administrative order.
Artikel I, onderdeel D (art. 77a, vijfde lid)
The Minister may issue substantive transitional rules by ministerial regulation, without waiting for an order in council, which lapses once the general administrative order enters into force.

parties: Asks how the government will handle cases where municipalities keep competent authority but provinces become budget holders, and whether project applications will undermine the programmatic approach.
What options does the government foresee?

Wants a guarantee that remediation funds stay reserved for that purpose, asks for a definition of 'serious' contamination in rural areas, and fears more bureaucracy from the shift of budgets to provinces.
However, these members want the government's guarantee that the budget intended for soil remediation remains reserved and earmarked for that purpose at all times.
Wel willen deze leden van de regering de garantie dat het budget bestemd voor bodemsanering wel ten alle tijden voor dat doel gereserveerd blijft en bestemd wordt.
Asks what specific remediation projects without a multi-year programme are, what substantive conditions apply to them, and why they do not fit a multi-year programme.
These members want to know what is meant by specific soil remediation projects for which no multi-year programme is necessary when applying.
Deze leden willen weten wat er wordt bedoeld met specifieke projecten van bodemsanering waarvoor bij een aanvraag geen meerjarenprogramma noodzakelijk is.

31514.s: The bill amends the Wet SUWI to merge the UWV and CWI into one employee insurance implementing body, make the UWV and SVB subject to the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen with exceptions, and strengthen the minister's control over the work and income chain. It also introduces an experimentation article allowing general administrative orders to depart from statute for up to five years, and removes several reporting and administrative provisions as deregulation.
31514.j: The memorandum justifies the experimentation delegation and the directions power by the need for flexibility to address implementation problems in the work and income chain, with a five-year limit and parliamentary pre-hearing.
q: However, it is not possible (even if desirable) to disentangle the minister's responsibility for the various components within the work and income chain.
Het is echter niet mogelijk (zo dit al wenselijk zou zijn) de verantwoordelijkheid van de minister voor de verschillende componenten binnen de keten werk en inkomen te ontvlechten.
d: appointment periods and legal position of management boards
rules on form of cooperation, cost compensation and indicators
rules on service delivery and client participation at locations
experiments that may depart from specified articles of the Wet SUWI
Art. 32d / 34a (Taken opgedragen bij AMvB of ministeriële regeling)
assignment of additional tasks to UWV and SVB
thresholds for prior ministerial consent on legal acts
shared electronic data systems among UWV, SVB and municipalities
p: The minister may issue binding directions to UWV or municipalities on location service delivery and, if not followed, take necessary measures themselves.
Allows temporary derogation from Wet SUWI provisions by general administrative order, limited to listed articles and five years, subject to a prior parliamentary hearing.
Shifts prior-approval thresholds for UWV and SVB legal acts toward ministerial instruments set by regulation rather than statute.
Applies the Kaderwet zelfstandige bestuursorganen to UWV and SVB, giving the minister general control powers over them.

parties: Questions whether the RWI can advise independently when UWV sits on it, and whether WSW indication independence is guaranteed after placement at UWV.
Does this not create the undesirable situation that the Council must advise on UWV's functioning while UWV itself sits on the Council?
Ontstaat hiermee niet de ongewenste situatie dat de Raad moet adviseren over het functioneren van UWV, terwijl UWV zelf in de Raad zitting heeft?
Asks how responsibilities between municipalities, WERKbedrijf and central government are divided, and questions the minister's directive power that bypasses municipal council democratic control.
A minister who uses his directive power thereby bypasses democratic control by the municipal council.
Een minister die gebruik maakt van zijn aanwijzingsbevoegdheid, passeert daarmee de democratische controle van de gemeenteraad.
Opposes the merger as enlarging bureaucracy, asks for fallback scenarios if service quality drops, and asks which concrete situations justify the minister's directive powers.
The combination of a large budget cut with the planned merger poses a major threat to the quality of service.
De combinatie van een grote bezuiniging met de voorgenomen fusie vormt een grote bedreiging voor de kwaliteit van dienstverlening.
Asks who decides when UWV and municipalities disagree and whether municipal policy room will be restricted, and asks how outcomes will be measured and evaluated.
Is there now a risk that this freedom will be restricted?
Bestaat er nu een risico dat deze vrijheid wordt beperkt?
Asks practical questions about intake, the operational date of the merger, and whether it will promote labour participation.
Does this merger also promote labour participation?
Bevordert deze fusie ook de arbeidsparticipatie?

Asks how parliament will be kept informed of results, whether a baseline measurement is planned, and why the evaluation of the change itself is not provided for; also asks about removal of checks and balances via advisory councils.
How will the government ensure that the House of Representatives is sufficiently informed about the development of the organisation and the results achieved?
Hoe gaat de regering er voor zorg dragen dat de Tweede Kamer voldoende geïnformeerd wordt over de ontwikkeling van de organisatie en de resultaten die behaald worden?

v.summary: The Raad van State advises on a bill merging the CWI and UWV and strengthening coordination in the work and income chain, supporting its aim but objecting to the ministerial instruction power and default-remedy rule toward municipalities, the steering of cooperation, and the closed data-sharing regime. The government reply accepts the data-regime and explanatory-memorandum changes, rejects amending the instruction power as proposed (justifying it by the single chain and single supervision regime), and explains why steering of cooperation is needed.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that ministerial instruction power over municipalities (artikel 10, derde lid) conflicts with the position of municipalities in the constitutional order, and the government did not adjust it.

The Afdeling finds the default-remedy rule toward municipalities insufficiently justified against article 124 Gemeentewet and the UWV instruction power redundant with the Kaderwet; the government justified the special rule but added explanation rather than removing it.

The Afdeling questions the need for central steering of inter-agency cooperation given municipalities' autonomy under the WWB; the government explained the necessity and clarified the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asks that the closed regime for disclosure of personal data be preserved without doubt, and the explanatory memorandum on article 62 was adjusted accordingly.
Technical amendments to the bill text and explanatory memorandum were made.

31541.s: The bill amends the Health Act to integrate the Health Research Council (RGO) into the Health Council, allowing members and chairs of the Health Council to be reappointed more often than the general advisory-body act permits. It also adds a statutory decision-making procedure for the Health Council's committees, modeled on the general advisory-body act.
31541.j: The memorandum justifies the deviation from the advisory-body act by the Health Council's unique working method, its need for scientific continuity and expertise, and the chair's need for a longer, separately counted term.
q: In view of the above, the Health Act, deviating from article 11 of the Advisory Bodies Framework Act, introduces the possibility of reappointing members three times.
Gezien het bovenstaande wordt in de Gezondheidswet, in afwijking van artikel 11 van de Kaderwet, de mogelijkheid opgenomen om leden drie maal te herbenoemen.

31550.s: The bill extends, on a temporary basis, the possibility for the College zorgverzekeringen to pay subsidies from the Algemeen Fonds Bijzondere Ziektekosten to MEE organisations that received subsidy in 2008, until a date set by ministerial regulation. The bill takes effect on 1 January 2009, with retroactive effect if published after 31 December 2008.
31550.j: The memorandum justifies leaving the end date to a ministerial regulation because the date cannot yet be determined, since the integrated early-help projects coordinated by MEE organisations have no fixed end point yet.
q: At this moment it cannot yet be said when that will be. Therefore it is arranged that the subsidy can be continued until a point in time to be determined by ministerial regulation.
Op dit moment is nog niet te zeggen wanneer dat zal zijn. Daarom wordt geregeld dat de subsidie tot een bij ministeriële regeling te bepalen tijdstip kan worden voortgezet.
d: end date of subsidy continuation for MEE organisations
rules for subsidy granting by the College zorgverzekeringen

parties: Asks how cooperation between MEE organisations and municipalities works and when the promised vision and definitive positioning of MEE will be available.
The CDA members ask the government by when both the vision on the development of MEE organisations and their definitive positioning can be expected.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen hierbij aan de regering op welke termijn zowel de visie over de ontwikkeling van de MEE-organisaties als de definitieve positionering van de MEE-organisaties te verwachten is.
Says the cabinet lacks a clear vision on client support and that Parliament has repeatedly blocked government attempts to move MEE funds, and asks when a clear vision will come.
Several attempts by the government to place MEE organisations' funds under the Wmo have been blocked by the House.
Verschillende pogingen van de regering om de middelen van MEE-organisaties onder te brengen in de Wmo zijn door de Kamer geblokkeerd.
Asks why a definitive arrangement for MEE has been postponed despite a known statutory end date of 31 December 2008.

These members ask why the implementation of a definitive arrangement for MEE organisations has been postponed, although the current subsidy method was known to have a hard statutory end date of 31 December 2008.

Genoemde leden vragen waarom het effectueren van een definitieve regeling voor de MEE-organisaties op de lange baan is geschoven, terwijl bekend was dat de huidige wijze van subsidiëring een harde wettelijke einddatum kende van 31 december 2008.
Welcomes the bill and asks the government to confirm that some form of continued support function for MEE will be chosen permanently.
The SGP members have noted with approval the bill to continue the subsidy to MEE organisations.
De leden van de SGP-fractie hebben met instemming kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel om de subsidie aan MEE-organisaties voort te zetten.

31700-V.s: This bill sets the 2009 budget (begrotingsstaten) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the baten-lastendienst CBI, and fixes the amounts in thousands of euros. It also allows the explanatory notes to present budget information per policy article in an experimental, politically focused format for 2007-2009, departing from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
31700-V.j: The memorandum justifies the departure from budget presentation rules as a time-limited experiment agreed with the Tweede Kamer to focus accountability on the main political priorities.
q: For the purpose of the experiment, it is necessary to deviate from several provisions of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for those years.
Ten behoeve van het experiment is het noodzakelijk voor die jaren af te wijken van een aantal bepalingen van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001.

31721.s: The bill amends the Spoedwet wegverbreding and the Tracéwet to simplify the environmental assessment burden for road projects, including relaxing the environmental impact report requirements, letting ministers set effect-assessment methods by ministerial regulation, and allowing air-quality permits based on the draft national air quality programme. It also adds a list of accelerated road projects and sets transitional and entry-into-force rules.
31721.j: The memorandum justifies the regulation-making powers as a way to simplify and improve effect-assessment methods and to reduce uncertainty, with the detailed rules to be worked out later.
q: To improve and simplify the way in which those effects are determined, a basis is provided for the ministers of Transport and of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment jointly to provide, by ministerial regulation, effect-assessment methods to better handle the uncertainties in effect assessment.

Teneinde de wijze waarop die effecten worden bepaald te verbeteren en te vereenvoudigen, wordt een grondslag geboden om bij ministeriële regeling van de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat en de minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer gezamenlijk, in effectbepalingsmethoden te voorzien
d: methods and starting points for assessing effects of road adaptation projects
methods and starting points for assessing effects of road projects
p: Exempts listed road projects from the Tracéwet and from several Wet milieubeheer environmental impact assessment provisions, reducing procedural review of projects.
Allows air-quality requirements to be met on the basis of the draft national programme before its final adoption, with limits set at 1% of threshold values.
Extends the same draft-programme-based air quality route to Tracéwet road decisions.
Repeals an article of the Spoedwet, the content of which the memorandum does not specify in the excerpt.

parties: Asks whether limiting the automatic annulment consequence under the Algemene wet bestuursrecht and shortening the court deadline is being pursued, and accepts applying the new regime to all Tracéwet projects.
Can the government indicate whether there are initiatives to broaden the application of article 6:22 of the General Administrative Law Act?
Kan de regering aangeven of er initiatieven zijn om de toepassing van artikel 6:22 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht te verruimen?
Supports the changes but asks why the notion of interested party is not narrowed and asks for justification of the two-year freezing of research data.
The VVD asks the government to explicitly justify why the concept of 'interested party' has not been further restricted in this proposal.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen wel of de regering nadrukkelijk wil motiveren waarom het begrip «belanghebbende» in dit voorstel niet verder is ingeperkt.
Objects to subordinating environmental and residents' interests such as health to speed, and to narrowing the air-quality study area and freezing data that the court could otherwise assess.
These members have serious objections to the restriction of the air-quality study area that must be carried out for a road adaptation decision.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie hebben grote bezwaren tegen de beperking van het studiegebied van het luchtkwaliteitonderzoek dat gedaan moet worden bij een wegaanpassingsbesluit.
Worries about carefulness and asks the government to drop the rule that decisions based on old data cannot be overtaken by better, current data.
These members therefore request the government to delete from this bill the provision that data on which decisions are based cannot be overtaken by better and more current data.

Deze leden verzoeken de regering dan ook om de bepaling dat gegevens waarop besluiten zijn gebaseerd, niet ingehaald kunnen worden door betere en actuelere gegevens, te schrappen uit dit wetsvoorstel.
Asks how the removal of the Commissie-MER's role and the deviation from the Elverding advice are justified, and why the bill was not submitted to the Raad van State.
Asks how contra-expertise is guaranteed before the draft decision and why the area for air-quality research is restricted by mandatory rule.
The PvdA members are curious how the government will ensure that unwelcome studies are also part of the data underlying the draft decision.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie zijn benieuwd hoe de regering ervoor gaat zorgen dat ook onwelgevallige onderzoeken behoren tot de gegevens die aan het ontwerpbesluit ten grondslag liggen.
Welcomes the search for balance between simpler research burden and necessary care, but questions the deviation from the cabinet's Elverding position and the broad scope of the Tracéwet change.
These members appreciate that the government seriously seeks a responsible balance between simplifying the research burden for road project decisions and the necessary care in decision-making.

Het spreekt deze leden aan, dat de regering serieus zoekt naar een verantwoord evenwicht tussen enerzijds het vereenvoudigen van de onderzoekslast voor de besluitvorming over wegprojecten en anderzijds de noodzakelijke zorgvuldigheid van de besluitvorming.
The committee asks that the Raad van State advise also on the Tracéwet changes, which it sees as missing from the existing advice.
The advice of the Raad van State on this bill appears incomplete, in that it seems to concern the changes to the Spoedwet Wegverbreding but not the changes to the Tracéwet.

Het advies van de Raad van State ten aanzien van dit wetsvoorstel lijkt onvolledig te zijn, in de zin dat het advies van de Raad van State wel lijkt te zien op de wijzigingen in de Spoedwet Wegverbreding, maar niet op de wijzigingen in de Tracéwet.
Supports swift but careful handling of the bill to make the country more accessible, and considers the questions answered.

To make the Netherlands more accessible again, it is necessary to enable the accelerated implementation of road projects whose decision-making has been delayed or stalled, mainly due to air quality problems, as this bill aims to do.

Om Nederland weer beter bereikbaar te maken, is het nodig om binnen afzienbare tijd de versnelde uitvoering van wegprojecten waarvan de besluitvorming vooral als gevolg van de luchtkwaliteitproblematiek is vertraagd of is stil komen te liggen, mogelijk te maken, zoals dit wetsvoorstel beoogt.
Supports the bill's aim of accelerating road projects and considers the questions answered.
These members consider the questions and remarks in the report adequately answered and the public handling of the bill sufficiently prepared.
Deze leden achten de in het verslag opgenomen vragen en opmerkingen afdoende beantwoord en de openbare behandeling van het wetsvoorstel daarmee voldoende voorbereid.
Asks the government to have the Council of State give renewed advice on the whole bill, including the Tracéwet amendments, and to have the Critical Support Team advise now.
These members urge the government to still request the Council of State to issue a (rush) advice on the proposed amendments to the Tracéwet.
Deze leden dringen er bij de regering op aan dat zij de Raad van State alsnog verzoekt een (spoed)advies uit te brengen ten aanzien van de voorgestelde wijzigingen in de Tracéwet.
Considers a Council of State advice on the whole bill, including the Tracéwet changes, indispensable for careful lawmaking.
A Council of State advice on the whole bill, including the proposed amendments to the Tracéwet, is seen by these members as indispensable in this context.

Een advies van de Raad van State ten aanzien van het gehele wetsvoorstel, dus ook ten aanzien van de voorgestelde wijzigingen in de Tracéwet, wordt door deze leden in dit kader als onontbeerlijk gezien.
Asks for Council of State advice on the Tracéwet changes and for the Critical Support Team to advise now, disagreeing with the government.
The members of the PvdA, VVD, SP and GroenLinks parties hold a different view.
De leden van de fracties van PvdA, VVD, SP en GroenLinks zijn een andere mening toegedaan.
Wants Council of State and Critical Support Team advice before the bill proceeds, to avoid later delay and objections.
These members urgently request the government to instruct the Critical Support Team to issue advice at this stage and to inform the House of the outcomes within six weeks.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering dringend om het Critical Support Team toch in deze fase op te dragen een advies uit te brengen en de Kamer binnen zes weken over de uitkomsten te informeren.
Asks for Council of State advice on the whole bill and Critical Support Team advice to ensure broad advisory review.
These members consider it necessary for careful handling of the bill that the envisaged amendments be advised on as broadly as possible.
Deze leden achten het voor een zorgvuldige behandeling van het wetsvoorstel nodig dat zo breed mogelijk over de voorziene wijzigingen is geadviseerd.
Joins calls for a renewed Council of State advice on the whole bill to prevent later delay and objections.
These members consider it important that legislation is developed in a careful manner.
Deze leden achten het van belang dat wetgeving op een zorgvuldige wijze tot stand komt.
Supports speedy but careful handling of the bill and considers the questions answered.
A swift yet careful treatment of this bill is considered important by these members.
Een voorspoedige en tegelijkertijd zorgvuldige behandeling van dit wetsvoorstel wordt door deze leden van belang geacht.
Their earlier concerns were eased by the limited project list, but they want a hearing and a postponed debate after the recess.
This means the PvdA members no longer consider it necessary for the government to ask the Raad van State for an advisory opinion on the proposed changes to the Tracéwet.
Dit maakt dat de leden van de fractie van de PvdA het niet langer noodzakelijk achten dat de regering de Raad van State alsnog zou verzoeken een (spoed)advies uit te brengen
Values the clear and limitative definition of the projects covered by both laws.
Important for these members is the clear and limitative delineation of the number of projects handled under both the Spoedwet wegverbreding and the Tracéwet.
Belangrijk voor deze leden is de heldere en limitatieve afbakening van het aantal projecten die behandeld worden in zowel de Spoedwet wegverbreding als de Tracéwet.
Wants swift but careful handling and awaits government reporting before judging whether an Raad van State advice is needed.
These members await the government's reporting before giving a final judgment on the need for further advice from the Raad van State.
Deze leden wachten de berichtgeving van de regering af voordat de leden een finaal oordeel geven omtrent de noodzaak van een nader advies van de Raad van State.
Objects to the government refusing to ask the Raad van State and the Critical Support Team for advice on a substantive law change.
Since the government wants to amend this law, advice from the Raad van State should accompany it.
Aangezien de regering deze wet wil wijzigen, hoort hierbij een advies van de Raad van State.
Considers the Tracéwet change substantial and urges the government to request Raad van State advice at short notice.
These members therefore repeat their request that the cabinet still obtain (urgent) advice from the Raad van State.
Deze leden herhalen derhalve hun verzoek aan het kabinet om alsnog (spoed)advies bij de Raad van State in te winnen

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the draft amendment to the Spoedwet wegverbreding and Tracéwet (simplifying research burden for road projects) be reconsidered, citing concerns over freezing research data, the air quality regime before the NSL is adopted, and regulation at ministerial level. The government's reply accepted a two-year limit on the data freeze, allowed correction of errors, added an air-quality safeguard, and defended ministerial-level technical rules while making several minor changes.
concerns: Freezing research data during decision-making was judged insufficiently justified and conflicting with the principle of deciding on facts at the time of decision; the government added a two-year limit and clarified error correction.

Freezing data could limit judicial review and the appellant's ability to contest the data, violating fair-trial principles; the government stated it does not intend to restrict judicial review and clarified the memorandum.

The air quality provision anticipates the NSL before the European Commission assesses it, carrying the risk that Commission objections could delay its entry into force; the government considered the risk acceptable without expanding the explanation.
Regulation of effect-assessment methods and principles by ministerial regulation was judged to belong in the statute; the government defended this as appropriate for technical rules.
Redactional comments on the wording of article I, parts C and D were adopted.

31811.s: The bill amends numerous social security and labour laws under the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (Verzamelwet SZW-wetgeving 2009), mostly technical corrections and alignments. It also expands inter-agency data sharing between inspectorates and ministry bodies and lets the Minister impose conditions and recover benefits for multi-year supplementary payments to municipalities.
31811.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as technical and as needed once a clear picture of data flows emerges, and notes CBP advice on specifying data sharing.
q: For the proposed provisions, the possibility is offered to set further rules by or under a general administrative order.
Ten aanzien van de voorgestelde bepalingen is de mogelijkheid geboden om bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur nadere regels te stellen.
d: conditions and recovery for multi-year supplementary benefit to municipalities
extension of reintegration budget period for ill employees via UWV assessment
rules on certificates, designations, withdrawal and cost recovery for certifying bodies
rules on data exchange between agencies and inspectorates
designation of other officials to supervise minimum wage compliance
rules on processing and onward sharing of data by investigators
further rules on repayment, supplementary income and application deadlines
Raad's annual regulation fixing levy surcharges, subject to ministerial approval
p: The Minister may attach conditions to, reduce, withdraw and recover multi-year supplementary payments to municipalities, with publication of advisory opinions.
Agencies may share personal data and use the citizen service number for inter-agency enforcement, limited by a proportionality test and future rules.
Investigators may pass collected data onward to supervisory bodies under rules set by general administrative order.

parties: Asks the government to separate technical from policy changes and to explain the financial and rights consequences for current and new benefit recipients.
These members therefore need a schematic overview indicating which changes in this omnibus bill can be regarded as (minor) policy and which are technical in nature.

Deze leden hebben daarom behoefte aan een schematisch overzicht waarin wordt aangeven welke wijzigingen van de onderhavige Verzamelwet SZW als (klein) beleid kunnen worden beschouwd en welke wijzigingen van technische aard zijn.
Questions who decides when data harms private life and whether citizens can go to court; supports single-use data exchange and a ban on discrimination.
Must people go to court if they believe their private life is being harmed?
Moeten mensen naar de rechter indien zij vinden dat hun persoonlijke levenssfeer wordt geschaad?
Asks for the reasons and concrete effects behind the changes, including the delegation of minimum-wage supervision to other supervisory bodies.
The members ask whether the delegation provision is superfluous if there is no intention to use it.
De leden vragen of de delegatiebepaling overbodig is indien er geen voornemen bestaat.
Asks for which cases each change applies and how data exchange between inspectorates is legally secured under privacy law, and about added administrative burdens.
Can the government indicate how the exchange of data between the labour inspectorate, other inspectorates and SZW is legally secured within privacy legislation?
Kan de regering aangeven op welk een wijze de uitwisseling van gegevens tussen de arbeidsinspectie, andere inspecties en SZW juridisch is geborgd in het kader van de privacywetgeving?
Questions the necessity of new workplace discrimination rules given existing laws, the administrative burden, and the role of company doctors in reviewing risk assessments.
Regarding part A, the SGP members ask the government about the necessity of the proposed amendments to the Working Conditions Act on psychosocial workload relating to workplace discrimination.

Bij onderdeel A vragen de leden van de SGP-fractie de regering naar de noodzaak van de voorgestelde wijzigingen van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet op het punt van psychosociale arbeidsbelasting met betrekking tot de discriminatie op de werkvloer.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised, on 21 November 2008, that the Verzamelwet SZW-wetgeving 2009 should be adjusted: data-sharing provisions in the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet and related laws should be limited to situations of actual inter-inspectorate cooperation, the inclusion of certified bodies needed justification, and the power to designate non-SZW supervisors under the Wet minimumloon needed explanation. The government's nader rapport of 9 December 2008 adopted the data-sharing limitation (necessity requirement, cooperation or regulation), justified the certified-body provisions, and explained the designation power, largely following the advice.
concerns: Data sharing between inspectorates and bodies should be limited to situations where cooperation arrangements are actually in place, since the current wording does not require necessity or actual cooperation.
Data exchange with certified bodies risks undermining the cooperation of certified persons and companies, and the justification in the explanatory memorandum was lacking.
The explanatory memorandum should justify why the power to designate non-SZW supervisors under the Wet minimumloon is considered necessary despite no current plans.

31965-XVIII.s: The bill amends the 2009 budget statements for the Ministry of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration (chapter XVIII), including the departmental budget and the baten-lastendiensten budget for the Rijksgebouwendienst, in connection with the spring memorandum. It sets the entry-into-force date as 1 June 2009 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The supplementary budget gives an updated picture of the implementation of the current year's budget.
De suppletore begroting geeft een geactualiseerd beeld van de uitvoering van de begroting van het lopende jaar.

32027.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2007/66/EC by adding a mandatory standstill period of at least fifteen calendar days between a contract award decision and contract signature, and by making unlawfully concluded public contracts annullable by a court. It also lets courts keep contracts in force for overriding public interest reasons, with alternative sanctions such as shortened contract duration and a fine of up to fifteen percent of contract value imposed by the Dutch competition authority (NMa).
32027.j: The memorandum justifies the powers as required by the EU directive to ensure effective and rapid legal remedies and deterrent sanctions, and says the choice to preserve contracts for overriding public interest reasons avoids rigid formalism.
q: The bill supplements the existing legal protection under civil (procedural) law.
Met het wetsvoorstel wordt de reeds bestaande rechtsbescherming van het burgerlijk (proces-)recht aangevuld.
d: Artikel 1 (onder a en i) / Artikel 1 (onder d)
thresholds and updated amounts via Article 16 references and related definitions
p: The NMa board is given power to impose administrative fines on contracting authorities, with the fine required to be deterrent, proportionate and effective and subject to appeal to the administrative court; the minister exercises these powers if the NMa itself is the contracting authority.
Courts may keep an unlawfully concluded contract in force on overriding public interest grounds, while the minister forwards judgments annually to the European Commission.

parties: Asks about the notice period and the discretion to decline annulment where general interests are at stake.
Can the government indicate where the line lies between economic interests and general interests, these members ask.
Kan de regering aangeven waar de grens ligt tussen economische belangen en algemene belangen, zo vragen deze leden.
Worries that the bill increases juridification and that annulment of concluded contracts raises risks for contracting parties; asks about liability and the position of the winning bidder.
Can the government rule out that this leads to more juridification and procedures started by parties who feel disadvantaged?
Kan de regering uitsluiten dat dit niet leidt tot meer juridisering en procedures, die opgestart worden door partijen die zich benadeeld voelen?

Questions whether the bill gives all categories of aggrieved parties adequate remedies, whether discriminatory criteria can ground annulment, and whether the short-term nature of kort geding undermines careful adjudication.
These members ask whether that does not de facto impede the carefulness of adjudication.
Deze leden vragen of dat niet de facto een belemmering voor de zorgvuldigheid van de rechtsspraak betekent.
Asks why the notice period was set at ten days for electronic notification, why reasons for award are non-binding, and how the fine percentage of 15% was determined.
These members ask why this non-binding choice was made rather than making certain elements mandatory.
Deze leden vragen waarom deze vrijblijvende keuze is gemaakt en niet is gekozen voor het verplicht stellen van bepaalde elementen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advises that the bill implementing the EU remedies directive for public procurement be aligned with the forthcoming overhaul of Dutch procurement law, clarify arbitration arrangements to meet EU requirements on judicial review and adjudicator qualifications, and extend automatic suspensive effect beyond summary proceedings to the main proceedings. The minister's reply (nader rapport) explains that the implementation is definitive, that the merger with the new procurement act is a technical step, that arbitration tension is resolved in article 20, and that suspensive effect is limited to summary proceedings for speed and to prevent misuse, with some amendments added after NMa testing.
concerns: Automatic suspensive effect is too narrowly implemented by limiting it to summary proceedings; the Afdeling advises extending it to main proceedings, which the government declined on grounds of speed and misuse risk.

Arbitration under the Dutch Code of Civil Procedure conflicts with EU requirements on judicial appeal and adjudicator qualifications, so adjustments are needed; the government added a provision in article 20 to remove the tension.
The relationship between this bill and the forthcoming procurement act, and whether the approach is temporary or definitive, was unclear and has been clarified in the explanatory memorandum.
Redactional correction in article 11 changing 'een dwingende reden' to 'dwingende redenen' to match the directive.

32036.s: The bill amends the Wet op het financieel toezicht and related laws to extend exemption notices, let the AFM set form requirements for disclaimers, and create an optional supervision regime (verklaring van ondertoezichtstelling) for funds offered only to qualified investors, plus technical fixes to supervisory cooperation and other financial statutes. The explanatory memorandum says the changes are mainly technical, with a few policy measures.
32036.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations as needed for technical implementation, form requirements and the voluntary regime's practical operation, with the AFM making detailed rules.
q: It is proposed to amend article 1:12 Wft so that investment institutions whose participation rights in the Netherlands are offered only to qualified investors may opt into a voluntary supervision regime.

Voorgesteld wordt om artikel 1:12 Wft op zodanige wijze te wijzigen dat daarin tot uitdrukking komt dat beleggingsinstellingen wier rechten van deelneming in Nederland uitsluitend worden aangeboden aan gekwalificeerde beleggers, kunnen opteren voor een vrijwillig toezichtregime.
d: form and content of exemption disclaimers for investment institutions
which provisions are subject to publication of fines via general administrative order
form of non-licensing disclaimers in advertising and offers
data to be supplied with application for supervision declaration
rules on content of advertisement and website disclosure of fund terms
rules on provisions (commissions) paid by providers
recognition of examination and permanent education institutes
rules on disclosure of confidential data by external accountants to third parties
ARTIKEL III, B / ARTIKEL VII, I (art. 29 WWB) and art. 263 Wft (new fourth paragraph)
further rules on deposit and investor compensation payment
other services designated as trust services
p: ARTIKEL I, L (art. 2:69a) and ARTIKEL I, I (art. 2:55)
The AFM may grant a supervision declaration and extend 'zware ontheffing' exemptions to ongoing supervision rules, giving the regulator wider discretion over which funds are supervised.
ARTIKEL VII, F/G/H (Wwft art. 23, 26, 27) and ARTIKEL VI (Wet handhaving consumentenbescherming)
Confidentiality duties on reports under the anti-money-laundering law and new enforcement powers for consumer protection expand executive handling of information with limited external review.

parties: Broadly positive about the bill's three improvements but asks why the warning cannot be banned outright and what concrete problems exist in practice.
These members are in principle positive about the bill.
Deze leden staan in principe positief tegenover het wetsvoorstel.
Asks detailed questions on the warning format, the 50,000 euro exemption threshold and the effects on consumers, questioning whether market parties should shape the warning.
Why are market parties involved in determining the form?
Waarom worden marktpartijen betrokken bij de bepaling van de vorm?
Asks why exemptions can be granted by ministerial regulation and how serious exemptions and voluntary supervision will be applied in practice.
Why was it chosen to allow exemptions from the rules of the Wft by means of a ministerial regulation?
Waarom is ervoor gekozen om het verlenen van vrijstellingen van de regels in de Wft door middel van een ministeriële regeling mogelijk te maken
Generally positive but asks for reconsideration of level playing field and competition concerns, and asks the AFM to inform market parties clearly about exemptions.
Does the government share the view of the VVD members that it is a task of the AFM to inform market parties properly about this?
Deelt de regering de mening van de leden van de VVD-fractie dat het een taak van de AFM is om de marktpartijen hier goed over te informeren?
Notes the bill is mostly technical and asks how supervisory costs are calculated and passed on to licence holders.
Why is no account taken of the fines imposed in this calculation?
Waarom wordt erbij deze berekening geen rekeninggehouden met de boetes die worden toegekend

32045.s: The bill reforms the Dutch criminal procedure rules for revision in favour of a former suspect: it broadens the grounds for revision (including a conflicting-judgments ground and a novum that no longer must be a factual circumstance), and lets the procureur-generaal order a further investigation via a commission, a research team or an examining magistrate before the Hoge Raad decides. It also widens the Hoge Raad's and the court's room to adjust sentences and provides compensation rules, with the State rather than the victim repaying damages where appropriate.
32045.j: The memorandum justifies the new investigative powers by the need to correct wrongful convictions and by the limits of the existing revision rules revealed in cases such as the Schiedam parkmoord.
d: composition, organisation, powers and working method of the advisory commission on further investigation
p: The procureur-generaal gains discretion to order a further investigation, appoint a research team and open a judicial preliminary investigation on a defendant's request, with the power to refuse only on limited grounds.
The novum ground is broadened so that a changed expert view or other non-factual circumstance can found revision, expanding protection for convicted persons rather than the executive.

parties: Supports a retrial safety valve but asks whether the procureur-generaal may depart from a commission's advice without control and whether the Hoge Raad panel size is excessive.
Does this not give the procureur-generaal too great and uncontrollable a power to disregard a well-considered advice, the CDA members ask.
Krijgt de procureur-generaal hiermee niet een te grote en oncontroleerbare macht om voorbij te gaan aan een weloverwogen advies, zo vragen de leden van de CDA-fractie.
Questions whether the Hoge Raad can impartially review its own earlier rulings and asks why no appeal lies against a procureur-generaal's refusal of further investigation.
Does this not put the critical capacity of the Hoge Raad too much to the test?
Stelt dit het kritisch vermogen van de Hoge Raad niet teveel op de proef?
Prefers an independent revisieraad with binding advice and investigative powers, criticises narrow access thresholds and the lack of remedy against negative decisions.
The SP members' preference remains firmly for the latter: an independent revision board outside the judiciary that can reassess cases with distance and an unbiased view and then issue binding advice.

De voorkeur van de leden van de SP-fractie blijft onverminderd uitgaan naar dat laatste: een onafhankelijke revisieraad buiten de rechterlijke macht die met enige distantie en met een onbevangen blik zaken opnieuw kan beoordelen en vervolgens bindend advies uit kan brengen.
Asks about the dual role of the Hoge Raad as cassation and retrial court, costs, parliamentary involvement in the AMvB, and why the 12-year and 10-year thresholds were chosen.
These members ask the government to explain why a lower limit was chosen and why the threshold for the advice request was set at ten years.
Deze leden verzoeken de regering nader toe te lichten waarom is gekozen voor een ondergrens en daarbij tevens in te gaan waarom die grens ten aanzien van de adviesaanvraag is gesteld op tien jaar.
Asks about access to legal aid and funding for forensic research for convicted persons seeking retrial, and why expert members on the commission are optional.
Can the government explain why only the possibility, and not the obligation, was introduced to include other experts alongside lawyers on the commission?
Kan de regering nader toelichten waarom enkel de mogelijkheid en niet de verplichting is geïntroduceerd om naast juristen ook andere deskundigen in de commissie op te nemen?
Asks whether changes in legislation can ground a retrial and how the court after remand handles sentencing discretion.
What practical significance should be given to this widening, now that the rule is kept that in a retrial in favour no sentence may be imposed exceeding that in the annulled judgment?

Welke feitelijke betekenis moet aan bedoelde verruiming worden toegekend, nu de regel wordt gehandhaafd dat bij een herziening ten voordele geen straf mag worden opgelegd die de bij het vernietigde arrest of vonnis te boven gaat?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on a draft bill reforming the criminal procedure rules on review (herziening) in favour of and against the convicted person, and raised concerns about the 'unknown to the judge' requirement, the authority deciding on further investigation for review to the detriment, retention of data of acquitted persons under Article 8 ECHR, and splitting the bill. The minister's reply (nader rapport) rejected or explained most points, adopted the split into two bills, and adjusted the explanatory memorandum and wording on data retention.
concerns: The Raad asked for clarification of the scope of the requirement that the judge was unaware of the new fact, which the minister addressed by explaining the requirement retains added value after Lucia de B.
The Raad advised replacing 'gegeven' with 'feiten of omstandigheden'; the minister kept 'gegeven' for reasons of legal meaning and readability.

The Raad held that the decision on further investigation for review to the detriment should be taken at a higher level, preferably by the procureur-generaal at the Hoge Raad, rather than the rechter-commissaris; the minister declined, citing risk of collusion and need for speed.

The Raad found retention of DNA and fingerprint data of acquitted persons disproportionate under Article 8 ECHR and not sufficiently justified; the minister supplemented the explanatory memorandum rather than changing the retention scheme.
The Raad advised considering splitting the bill into separate bills on review in favour and review to the detriment; the minister followed this advice.
Two redactional remarks: the first (appeal period wording) was adopted, the second (replacing 'bewijsmiddelen' with 'bescheiden') was not, for stated reasons.

32207.s: The bill sets rules for the police, fire service, disaster management and crisis control on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba, including a police corps and fire brigade under the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations. It delegates many detailed rules to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations and shifts several operational and supervisory functions to the Rijksvertegenwoordiger and ministers.
32207.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need for legal basis for administrative, financial and supervisory relations, uniformity and quality of care.
q: Matters such as administrative, financial and supervisory relations require a basis in a formal statute.
Zaken als bestuurlijke, financiële en toezichtverhoudingen vergen een grondslag in een wet in formele zin.
d: tasks performable by certain civil officials
designation of persons under Koninklijke marechaussee protection
handling of complaints about police conduct
legal position and medical fitness of police officers
safety and standardisation of fire equipment
fire personnel ranks, requirements and training
organisation of disaster and crisis management
royal decision bringing emergency articles into force
information and communication systems and frequencies
p: Emergency articles can be activated by royal decision, with the Minister able to take over local powers of the governor and Rijksvertegenwoordiger when general interest demands it.
The Rijksvertegenwoordiger may give binding directions to the governor on public order and disaster policy and appoint officials to operational leadership.
Complaints about police and fire personnel are handled internally by the corps manager and the Minister rather than by an independent body.

parties: Asks whether a voorhangprocedure should be added so parliament can be informed on the matters the bill delegates to ministerial regulations, and notes the bill is full of general administrative orders.
Is the government willing, analogous to the Veiligheidsregio's Act, to include a pre-consultation procedure in this bill on the same points as in that act?
Is de regering bereid om, analoog aan de Wet Veiligheidsregio’s, op dezelfde punten als in die wet, een voorhangprocedure in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel op te nemen?
Argues the planning obligations are too burdensome for three small public bodies with limited administrative capacity and may be merely bureaucratic.
With the Council, the PvdA members believe that given the small scale and limited administrative capacity, this would quickly be too great a burden for the three public bodies.
Met de Raad menen de leden van de PvdA-fractie dat gelet op de kleine schaal en beperkte bestuurlijke draagkracht dit al snel een te grote belasting zijn voor de drie openbare lichamen.
Raises doubts about the choice of a separate police corps for the islands and asks for clarity on the mandating of korpsbeheerderschap and when a decision will be taken.
They ask for further clarity on the options being considered and on when a decision will be taken.
Zij vragen nadere duidelijkheid over de mogelijkheden die daarbij overwogen worden en wanneer daarover een besluit zal worden genomen.
Asks how far the minister of BZK retains influence over the fire and police corps if korpsbeheerderschap is mandated, and about exceptions to the Wet politiegegevens.
To what extent can the minister of BZK then still retain influence over the fire brigade and police corps?
In welke mate kan de minister van BZK dan nog invloed behouden op het brandweer- en politiekorps?

Warns that the minister of BZK would act as korpsbeheerder, rule-maker and inspector-reporting-to-himself, creating a lack of checks and balances, and suggests the Rijksvertegenwoordiger or another body instead.
Do these tasks not conflict improperly with one another?
Raken deze taken niet op oneigenlijke wijze met elkaar verwerven?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill on police, fire services, disaster management and crisis control for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba is broadly supported but needs revision: the layered legal architecture is complex, cross-island powers and planning obligations are burdensome, and the processing of police data and supervision are underregulated. The government's reply accepted most points, restructured chapter 2, narrowed delegations, shortened the title, and left some points (e.g. detailed police data safeguards) for later legislation.
concerns: The layered and complex architecture of rules for the BES police corps risks lack of transparency; the government restructured chapter 2 to follow the order of the Rijkswet politie.
The bill contains many delegation provisions (36 AMvB, 13 ministerial regulation) that should be reduced; the government made several delegations facultative or removed them.
The planning and regulatory obligations are heavy for small islands with limited administrative capacity; the government kept planning duties but simplified some elements.
Cross-island emergency powers of the Rijksvertegenwoordiger are unclear; the government retained the power to give instructions but allowed appointing an operational leader and made a staff optional.
Criminal offences must be defined in formal legislation rather than by AMvB; the government moved the relevant provisions into the statute.

Police data processing needs statutory safeguards and independent supervision; the government referred detailed safeguards to the Wet politiegegevens and designated the data protection authority as supervisor, with a follow-up amendment planned.
Drafting points were largely accepted, including a shorter citation title (Veiligheidswet BES) and numerous editorial corrections.

32216.s: The bill introduces a usage-based road charge (kilometerprijs) on motor vehicles in the Netherlands, collected via mandatory onboard registration devices and certified service providers, replacing the existing vehicle taxes (BPM, MRB, BZM) over a phased rollout. It sets base and peak tariffs, exemptions, enforcement and data-protection rules, and delegates detailed tariff setting, peak zones, registration device specifications and phasing largely to ministerial regulations and general administrative orders (AMvB).
32216.j: The memorandum justifies delegation to ministerial regulations and an AMvB by the need for flexibility to adjust peak zones and tariffs quickly, and treats the Spitsbesluit as a political rather than judicially reviewable decision.
q: Adoption by or pursuant to a general administrative order can be done within a few months and, combined with consultation duties towards decentralised governments and road managers, provides sufficient safeguards for careful decision-making while retaining the necessary flexibility.

Vaststelling bij of krachtens AMvB kan binnen een aantal maanden en biedt daarmee in combinatie met de overlegverplichtingen met decentrale overheden en wegbeheerders voldoende waarborgen voor zorgvuldige besluitvorming en tegelijkertijd de benodigde flexibiliteit.
d: rules for foreign-registered car notification and termination
conditions for wheelchair installation weight exclusion
peak road sections, directions and periods
height of peak tariff per kilometre
conditions for exemption from kilometre charge
p: Peak road sections, periods and charge levels are fixed by general administrative order rather than by statute, with only consultation and public comment and no direct judicial review of the designation.
Challenges to invoices are limited to defects shown by a re-inspection report, with a minimum amount threshold for objections.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised on the draft Wet kilometerprijs, finding the bill not positively advisable in its current form due to formal, legal protection, and financing concerns. The minister's nader rapport responds point by point, adopting many of the Raad's suggestions on legal protection, technical registration and enforcement while explaining or rejecting others.
concerns: The Raad advised treating the invoice as a reviewable decision and adding legal protection, which the government adopted with bezwaar and beroep provisions.
Concerns about parate executie, dwanginvordering without judicial intervention and the broad instrumentarium were partly addressed, with the government defending several enforcement tools.
The Raad advised that exemptions must be set by algemene maatregel van bestuur rather than ministerial regulation, and the government agreed.
The Raad questioned the kilometerprijs as a bestemmingsheffing and the budgetary logic of funding infrastructure from it, to which the government responded with explanations but limited changes.
Concerns about technical reliability, the registratievoorziening's verifiability, herkeuring and cost bearing led to added safeguards and a commitment to practical tests before introduction.
The Raad flagged compliance with the Eurovignette directive and EU services rules; the government argued compliance and added explanation in the memorie van toelichting.
Concerns about proportionality of the enforcement instruments such as gijzeling and buitengebruikstelling were answered by the government with justifications.

32222-V.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (supplementary budget linked to the autumn budget memorandum), changing appropriations across policy articles and the CBI agency budget. It sets the effective date of the amendment and orders its publication.
q: Having considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2009
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2009

32225.s: The bill amends the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to let the Minister designate mopeds and special mopeds without EU type approval for road admission, and to allow ministerial regulations to permit certain vehicles and equipment without approval. It also makes technical corrections and extensions to the Wet rijonderricht motorrijtuigen 1993, including lengthening a training-certificate period from four to twelve months.
32225.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial designation power by simplifying admission of special mopeds, and says the ministerial regulation will set the detailed test requirements and access policy.
q: By means of this part, the conditions are included on the basis of which the Minister of Transport and Water Management can designate mopeds for which no European type approval is required.
Door middel van dit onderdeel worden de voorwaarden opgenomen op grond waarvan de Minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat bromfietsen waarvoor geen Europese typegoedkeuring is vereist, kan aanwijzen.
d: designation of mopeds without EU type approval and details of the designation
categories of vehicles and components admitted to traffic without type approval
scope and content of certified courses and possible extension of theoretical refresher training
p: The Minister may designate individual or type-approved mopeds for road admission without EU type approval based on safety aspects, a discretionary power the bill creates.
Ministerial regulation may exempt vehicle categories and safety equipment from the usual approval requirement for road use.

parties: Asks how enforcement services can verify exemptions and distinguish user categories on the pavement, and why Actal did not select the bill for business impact review.
These members ask how enforcement services can assess in practice whether a user holds an exemption and is therefore entitled to use the pavement.
Deze leden vragen hoe de handhavende diensten in de praktijk kunnen beoordelen of een gebruiker in bezit is van een ontheffing en dus met recht gebruik maakt van het trottoir.
Welcomes admission of the Segway and disabled access, but asks on which criteria the minister will decide to admit a vehicle category without type approval.
These members ask on the basis of which criteria the minister will decide to designate a vehicle category or component that may be admitted to road traffic without type approval.

De leden van de SP-fractie vragen aan de hand van welke criteria de minister zal besluiten tot de aanwijzing van een voertuigcategorie ofonderdeel die/dat zonder typegoedkeuring kan worden toegelaten tot het wegverkeer.
Supports the bill and considers that the insurance plate adequately compensates for the enforcement benefits of registration.
On registration plates, the VVD members believe the proposed mandatory insurance plates sufficiently compensate for the enforcement benefits of registration.

Inzake de kentekenplicht zijn de leden van de VVD-fractie van mening dat de voorgenomen verplichte aanwezigheid van verzekeringsplaatjes de voordelen van kentekening voor de handhaving voldoende ondervangen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised, on a draft bill amending the Wegenverkeerswet 1994 to admit special mopeds (including Segways) without Dienst Wegverkeer approval, that the new admission system, the absence of Europese typegoedkeuring under Directive 2002/24/EG, the absence of a licence plate, and the use of such vehicles on pavements by disabled people be better motivated and in part revised. The government's nader rapport accepted most remarks by adding justification and testing requirements to the memorie van toelichting, and kept the pavement exemption while explaining why it departs from the SWOV advice.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned the new admission system without Dienst Wegverkeer approval and asked for a substantive justification; the government added justification and technical testing (emergency braking, evasive manoeuvres, speed control) but kept the system.
The Afdeling doubted why Directive 2002/24/EG type approval is not required; the government cited a Commission letter and notification under Directive 98/34/EG, adding explanation to the memorie.
The Afdeling advised mandatory licence plates for the new subcategory; the government rejected this on administrative burden grounds, though it expanded the explanation.

The Afdeling asked for attention to pedestrian injury risk and enforcement problems of allowing disabled users on pavements; the government added this discussion but kept the exemption to protect mobility.
The Afdeling made a minor redactional remark on article I, onderdeel D, which was incorporated.

32243.s: The bill abolishes the municipalities of Bodegraven and Reeuwijk and establishes a new municipality, Bodegraven-Reeuwijk, on the combined territory. It makes consequential adjustments to judicial districts, police areas, safety region provisions, and election timing.
32243.j: The memorandum justifies the merger by the new municipality's administrative capacity to perform basic municipal tasks, which the province has assessed positively.
q: The administrative capacity of the newly formed municipality Bodegraven-Reeuwijk is also assessed positively by the province.
De bestuurskracht van de nieuw te vormen gemeente Bodegraven-Reeuwijk wordt ook door de provincie positief beoordeeld.

parties: Asks whether the capacity problems could be solved through cooperation instead of merger, whether the staff quality gain requires hiring new officials, and how the long-term regional vision relates to this merger.
The CDA members read that administrative capacity in both municipalities was still sufficient but would decline quickly without investment in the capacity and quality of the organisation.
De leden van de CDA-fractie lezen dat de bestuurskracht in beide gemeenten nog voldoende was maar snel zou afnemen als niet werd geïnvesteerd in de capaciteit en de kwaliteit van de organisatie.

Asks how the government assesses the durability of the merger against the expected capacity and the long-term vision, what the effect is on Gouda's development options, and how citizens are involved in local governance.
They therefore want to know what influence the merger has on the development options of the municipality of Gouda and how the new municipality will shape cooperation with that municipality.

Daarom willen zij graag weten welke invloed de herindeling heeft op de ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden van de gemeente Gouda en hoe de samenwerking met deze gemeente door de nieuwe gemeente wordt vormgegeven.

Stresses that mergers should proceed only from below with genuine popular support, demands proper evidence of how local support was measured, and questions what happens if expected efficiency gains fail and the budget falls short.
The government can only assess this if sound research into popular support has taken place. How was this measured in the municipalities concerned?
Dit kan de regering alleen beoordelen als er deugdelijk onderzoek naar het draagvlak heeft plaatsgevonden. Hoe is dit in de betreffende gemeenten gemeten?

Holds that such far-reaching changes must be carried by a majority of residents and that binding referenda should be held for municipal mergers; argues the process here was not adequate and lacks a careful procedure.
In the view of the PVV members, binding referenda should always be held for municipal mergers.
In de visie van de leden van de PVV-fractie dienen er bij gemeentelijke herindelingen altijd bindende referenda te worden gehouden.

Questions the link the explanatory memorandum draws between municipal size and administrative capacity, notes that regional safety councils may weaken rather than strengthen local ties on safety, and asks how the 40/20/20/20% cost distribution was constructed.
Particularly on safety, in the view of the SGP members the formation of safety regions is more likely to weaken the link between the municipality and safety than to strengthen it.

Met name op het gebied van de veiligheid is naar de mening van de leden van de SGP-fractie door de vorming van veiligheidsregio's eerder een verzwakking van de band tussen de gemeente en het thema veiligheid dan een versterking aan de orde.
Welcomes the bill and has no questions in the written preparation.
The bill gives these members no reason to ask questions in the written preparation of the parliamentary debate.
Het wetsvoorstel geeft deze leden geen aanleiding tot het stellen van vragen in de schriftelijke voorbereiding van de parlementaire behandeling.

Notes broad support for the merger and its role in protecting the landscape, but asks whether the 10-15 year durability is sufficient, what the efficiency gains will be against the lower fund allocation, and whether Bodegraven-Reeuwijk is the definitive name.
These members want to know from the government whether it considers this sufficiently durable.
Deze leden willen graag van de regering weten of zij dit voldoende duurzaam acht.

32252.s: The bill amends the Environmental Management Act to introduce noise production ceilings for motorways and railways, moving Chapter IX of the Noise Nuisance Act into the Environmental Management Act. It also sets out noise maps, action plans, a public noise register, and procedures for setting, changing and exceeding the ceilings, with the Minister able to grant exemptions and overrun decisions.
32252.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and exemptions by the need for flexibility in technical noise rules and by the lack of effective protection under the current Noise Nuisance Act.
q: The Noise Nuisance Act provides insufficient protection against the consequences of growing traffic.
De Wet geluidhinder biedt onvoldoende bescherming tegen de gevolgen van de groei van het verkeer.
d: designation of brongegevens and geluidbeperkende maatregelen
rules for calculating noise on noise maps
acoustic quality requirements for roads and railways
adoption of the noise ceiling map
noise ceilings for existing roads and railways by general measure
overrun decisions exceeding maximum noise values
p: Ministers may, at the manager's request, adopt overrun decisions allowing noise ceilings that exceed the statutory maximum value for affected dwellings.
The Minister may grant exemptions from compliance with noise ceilings for up to five years in special circumstances.
The Minister may declare the manager's obligation to take noise-protection measures lapsed where the owner refuses cooperation.
Until 2018 ceilings may only be lowered at municipal request for municipal measures, with the Minister given discretion on later review.

parties: Questions whether the ceilings will block housing and urban development and whether municipalities can fulfil their role, and asks how the rules relate to the VNG's fears.
These members point out that this has consequences not only for the four largest municipalities but also for large numbers of homes in other municipalities along national infrastructure.
Deze leden wijzen erop dat dit niet alleen gevolgen heeft voor de vier grootste gemeenten maar ook voor grote aantallen woningen bij andere gemeenten langs rijksinfrastructuur.
Asks how firm housing norms are, whether ceilings can be raised and under what conditions, and how the plan fits existing remediation plans.
The PvdA members note that noise production ceilings set the upper limit for permitted noise output of a road or railway.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie merken op dat geluidsplafonds de bovengrens vastleggen voor de toegestane geluidsproductie van een weg of spoorweg.

Objects to the 1.5 dB headroom and discretionary exemptions, the minimal enforcement section, the minister of Transport's dual role, and the Council of State's criticism of norms delegated to lower regulations.
The Council of State urges that the norms, and also the criteria for exemptions, be included in the bill itself.
De Raad van State dringt erop aan om de normen, maar ook criteria voor ontheffingen e.d., in het wetsvoorstel op te nemen.

Doubts residents will be adequately protected; objects to the generous 1.5 dB margin, the vague cost-effectiveness criterion, the minister's enforcement role and the lack of rights for stakeholders to demand compliance.
The GroenLinks members consider the blanket 1.5 dB increase too generous.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie vinden de generieke verhoging met 1,5dB te ruim.

Welcomes the ceilings as a step forward but asks about long-term protection, discretion in local measures, unclear implementing rules left to lower regulation affecting municipalities, and the cost-effectiveness basis.
These members ask what happens if remediation does not produce the desired result?
