q: Case law shows that it must be assessed case by case which protection under the writings protection can be derived from the Copyright Act.
Uit de jurisprudentie volgt dat van geval tot geval moet worden bezien welke bescherming op grond van de geschriftenbescherming aan de Auteurswet kan worden ontleend.
d: entry into force date by royal decree

parties: Supports abolishing writings protection as part of modernising copyright, but asks questions on the effects for programme data supplied by the NPO.
The VVD members took a positive stance on the bill that aims to abolish writings protection.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben met een positieve grondhouding kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel dat strekt tot afschaffen van de geschriftenbescherming.
Supports the bill as keeping copyright focused on protecting original creative work, and asks about a joint vision and further measures.
They support the premise that protecting the creator's creative achievement is important for maintaining support.
Zij ondersteunen het uitgangspunt dat bescherming van de creatieve prestatie van de maker van belang is voor behoud van het draagvlak.
Asks for estimates of how often writings protection is used to protect investments and for examples, and about consultation responses.
Can the government give an estimate of the number of cases in which writings protection is used to protect an investment?
Kan de regering een schatting geven van het aantal gevallen waarin de geschriftenbescherming wordt ingezet ter bescherming van een investering?
Accepts abolition given positive advice and reactions, but raises doubts about the legal basis and tariff of the NPO programme-data licence fee and the consultation method.
Given the positive advice and reactions received on the bill, they can agree to letting writings protection for non-original writings lapse.
Mede gezien de bij het wetsvoorstel uitgebrachte positieve adviezen en reacties, kunnen zij zich vinden in het laten vervallen van de geschriftenbescherming van niet-oorspronkelijke geschriften.
Supports the aim of modernising copyright but asks whether such large steps are being taken immediately and requests a table of EU negotiation topics and the government's view on fair use.
They endorse the goal of modernising copyright but wonder whether large steps are being taken straight away in this way.
Zij onderschrijven de doelstelling ervan, namelijk om het auteursrecht te moderniseren, maar vragen zich af of op deze manier nu direct grote stappen worden gezet.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division supports abolishing protection of writings lacking original character under the Auteurswet, but advises against a separate economic-impact study, noting the internet consultation was too limited to draw conclusions and no weighty economic objections emerged. The government's reply explains that the debate, the Commissie Auteursrecht advice and the consultation showed no weighty opposing interests, and it amended the explanatory memorandum accordingly without conducting further research.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum does not specify the scope of writings protection and its abolition, and should be clarified; the government amended the memorandum.

The internet consultation is not a suitable method for assessing economic effects, and the advisory division questions whether further economic research is needed; the government did not commission such research but amended the explanation.

34034.s: The bill amends the Dutch Criminal Code to implement EU Directive 2013/40/EU on attacks against information systems, doubling several maximum prison terms and adding aggravated offences for attacks using botnets, causing serious damage, or targeting critical infrastructure. It also creates new offences for producing or distributing hacking tools and passwords, and adjusts the Code of Criminal Procedure accordingly.
34034.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as implementing EU obligations and notes that the higher maximum penalties give prosecutors and judges more room to reflect aggravating circumstances, so no further implementation is needed.
q: Because this bill raises the maximum penalties of the basic offences, the public prosecution service and the judge have gained more room to take the said aggravating circumstance into account.

Doordat in dit wetsvoorstel de strafmaxima van de basisdelicten zijn verhoogd, hebben het openbaar ministerie en de rechter meer ruimte gekregen om rekening te houden met de genoemde strafverzwarende omstandigheid.

parties: Asks which organisations are involved in international public-private cybercrime cooperation, who leads it, and whether the NCSC retains overall responsibility.
In particular they ask whether the department, together with the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC), still has the lead and ultimate responsibility.
In het bijzonder vragen zij of het departement met het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum (NCSC) nog steeds de regie heeft en eindverantwoordelijk is.
Asks whether the government will reconsider the OM's advice for a single Criminal Code title, questions EU member state ratification gaps, and asks about data collection and sharing by the THTC.
The government does not want to support this proposal but wants to weigh it further. Will the government come back to this?
De regering wil dit voorstel niet ondersteunen maar nader afwegen. Komt de regering hier nog op terug?

Asks whether police and justice experience problems from offences scattered across the Criminal Code, whether a separate title is desirable, and whether the Criminal Code will be modernised alongside the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Does the government consider it desirable to introduce a separate title?
Acht de regering het wenselijk met een afzonderlijke titel te komen?
Questions the added value of the implementation law for the Netherlands, given existing protections, and asks whether a subsidiarity and proportionality test was carried out.
Has the government carried out a subsidiarity and proportionality test for this bill?
Heeft de regering bij dit wetsvoorstel een subsidiariteits- en proportionaliteitstoets uitgevoerd?

Asks for statistical substantiation of the government's enforcement ambitions, numbers of investigations and prosecutions, DigiD misuse and municipal vulnerabilities, and the reasons for the placement of offences in the Criminal Code.
Can the government substantiate with figures its position that it wants to tackle the increasing risks of cybercrime vigorously?
Kan de regering cijfermatig de stellingname staven dat zij de toenemende risico's van cybercriminaliteit krachtig wil aanpakken.

34052.s: The bill approves the Dutch government's intention to terminate the 1972 General Social Security Convention and the 1972 Administrative Agreement with Morocco for the European part of the Netherlands. The explanatory memorandum sets out the financial and enforcement consequences of termination, including loss of export obligations and weakened benefit controls.
34052.j: The memorandum justifies termination on cost savings and the limited benefits of the Convention beyond WWB controls, and states the government does not wish to refrain from the measures despite uncertain effects.
q: In addition, the government notes that outside the WWB controls the Convention offers few benefits to the Netherlands.
Daarnaast constateert de regering dat het Verdrag buiten de controles in het kader van de WWB weinig voordelen biedt voor Nederland.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that unilateral termination of the 1972 social security treaty with Morocco can be justified, but that the explanatory memorandum must weigh all relevant consequences, including effects on controls over benefit exports and the imminent Association Decision. The government reply states that the memorandum was supplemented to address the consequences for enforcement, other policy areas, and the Association Decision, and that the recommended wording was adopted.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum must explain the weighing behind termination, including consequences for other policy areas beyond social security and for the imminent Association Decision.

Termination would weaken Dutch ability to control the lawfulness of benefits still exported to Morocco under transitional law and under the new Association Decision, which the memorandum must address.
The memorandum must address the EU-Morocco Association Decision's export obligations and its limited control possibilities compared with the existing treaty.

The memorandum should include an overview of benefits to be exported under transitional law, including WAJONG benefits, and clarify that health-care benefits under the Zvw and AWBZ fall outside the export concept.

34061.s: The bill amends the Wet uitvoering wetten voor verzetsdeelnemers en oorlogsgetroffenen to give the Pensioen- en Uitkeringsraad and the Sociale verzekeringsbank a statutory basis for administering the Algemene Oorlogsongevallenregeling Indonesië, replacing the former Commissie AOR. It also sets transitional rules moving pending applications and appeals to the new bodies.
34061.j: The memorandum justifies the change as safeguarding continuity and quality of service to beneficiaries and keeps the existing decision-allocation structure of the Wuvo.
q: The only change is that from the date of entry into force, clients will receive their benefit or allowance from the SVB, division Verzetsdeelnemers en Oorlogsgetroffenen, just as under the laws for resistance participants and war victims.

Het enige dat verandert is dat de cliënten vanaf de datum van inwerkingtreding net als in het kader van de wetten voor verzetsdeelnemers en oorlogsgetroffenen hun uitkering of tegemoetkoming zullen ontvangen van de SVB, afdeling Verzetsdeelnemers en Oorlogsgetroffenen.

34106.s: The bill amends the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur to disapply the Wet dwangsom for Wob requests, removing the ability to collect penalty payments for late decisions. It adds a new article 15a letting courts set longer decision periods and deny reimbursement of court fees and costs when requesters are unreasonable or misuse the procedure.
34106.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to misuse of the Wob to collect penalty payments and costs, which courts and the government say existing legal tools cannot adequately address.
q: The evaluation report shows that administrative bodies currently lack (legal) means to put an end to this misuse.
Het evaluatierapport maakt zichtbaar dat het de bestuursorganen op dit moment ontbreekt aan (juridische) middelen om aan dit misbruik een eind te maken
p: Disapplies the Wet dwangsom penalty-payment regime for Wob decisions, removing a financial incentive for timely decisions and weakening citizens' legal protection against administrative delay.

Lets courts set longer decision deadlines and waive fee and cost reimbursement for requesters deemed uncooperative or misusing the procedure, shifting some burden onto requesters while keeping court review in place.

parties: Supports ending penalty-payment abuse and asks whether alternatives exist to push authorities to decide on time.
The VVD members therefore agree that the Dwangsom and Appeal for Failure to Decide Act will no longer apply to the Wob.
De leden van de VVD-fractie zijn het er dan ook mee eens dat de Wet dwangsom en beroep bij niet tijdig beslissen niet langer van toepassing zal zijn op de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur.
Regrets losing the penalty regime as a tool to force timely decisions, accepts the need to address abuse, and asks how a claimant's cooperation will be judged.
Considering this, the PvdA members conclude that in the short term there is unfortunately no other option than decoupling the penalty regime from the Wob.
Dit overziende brengt het de leden van de PvdA-fractie tot de overweging dat er op korte termijn helaas geen andere mogelijkheid is dan de dwangsom-regeling los te koppelen van de Wob.
Supports the goal of preventing abuse but asks the government to guarantee that good-faith requesters can still get court-cost reimbursement.
They ask how the government can guarantee that good-faith requesters will still be eligible for these reimbursements.
Zij vragen hoe de regering kan garanderen dat goedwillende verzoekers hier wel voor in aanmerking komen.
Questions the necessity and timing of the bill and whether existing case law and the Dordrecht ruling already provide adequate remedies.
Has the government underestimated the complexity of the Wet open overheid initiative?
Heeft de regering de complexiteit van het initiatiefvoorstel Wet open overheid onderschat?
Fears reduced access to government information for good-faith requesters and higher costs from losing the penalty regime, especially for journalists.
On the one hand they recognise the need to prevent abuse of the Wob to collect penalties, on the other they fear this may restrict access to government information for well-meaning requesters.

Enerzijds erkennen zij de noodzaak misbruik van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur teneinde dwangsommen te innen te voorkomen, anderzijds vrezen zij dat hiermee mogelijk de toegang tot overheidsinformatie beperkt wordt voor welwillende Wob-verzoekers.
Questions proportionality and side effects, and worries that the court route will be too costly a barrier for requesters.
Questions why the government tabled a separate bill while the Wet open overheid initiative is pending and asks about transparency steps and the Tromsø Convention.
These members ask to what extent the government considers this proper toward the initiators of the Wet open overheid.
Deze leden vragen zich af in welke mate de regering dit fatsoenlijk acht jegens de initiatiefnemers van de Wet open overheid.
Supports tackling abuse but asks whether timely decisions by authorities may slip and how the new court route and consultation duties will work in practice.
They ask to what extent authorities decide such requests on time.
Zij vragen zich af in hoeverre de overheden tijdig beslissen op zulke verzoeken.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State raised no substantive objections to the bill amending the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur to prevent abuse, and advised sending it to parliament, with only redactional remarks on article 15a and recent case law. The government adopted the case-law addition but declined the proposed redaction of article 15a, explaining that it would change the substance and that consistency requires the same categories of decisions to fall under the special direct-appeal regime.
concerns: The Afdeling proposed a different wording of article 15a, first paragraph, which the government did not adopt because it would alter the substance.
The explanatory memorandum should be supplemented with recent case law of the Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak, which the government did.

34115.s: This bill approves on behalf of the Netherlands the EU–Euratom–Georgia Association Agreement concluded in Brussels on 27 June 2014, which requires parliamentary consent under the Constitution. It contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive and no new powers for the executive, and the Agreement is applied to Georgian territory only once Tbilisi can guarantee implementation.
q: We ... have agreed and resolved ... The Association Agreement concluded in Brussels on 27 June 2014 ... is approved for the European part of the Netherlands.
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De op 27 juni 2014 te Brussel tot stand gekomen Associatieovereenkomst ... wordt goedgekeurd voor het Europese deel van Nederland.

parties: Asks how the agreement's territorial application to South Ossetia and Abkhazia would be guaranteed and under what circumstances the Association Council could suspend it.
What circumstances could give the Association Council cause to decide to suspend the application of the agreement in the said regions?
Welke omstandigheden zouden aanleiding kunnen vormen voor de Associatieraad om te beslissen om de toepassing van het akkoord in de genoemde regio's op te schorten?

Asks whether the agreements can raise fundamental values such as human rights, democracy and the rule of law, including minority language rights, and whether ratification should be finished before the Riga summit.
In this context, these members ask to what extent the Association Agreements offer opportunities to raise precisely these important issues.
In dat kader vragen deze leden in hoeverre de Associatieakkoorden mogelijkheden bieden om juist deze belangrijke kwesties aan de orde te stellen.

Questions whether prosecutions of former ministers are politically motivated and asks how the suspension procedure would work given concerns about democracy, human rights and the rule of law in Georgia.
Are the concerns of NGOs about the political motivation of these court cases etc. shared?
Worden de zorgen van ngo's over de politieke motivering van deze rechtszaken etc. gedeeld?

Supports the association agreement but notes persisting concerns about the rule of law in Georgia and asks why the government only addressed domestic politics after criticism from the Council of State.
In certain areas, concerns about the rule of law persist.
Op deelgebieden blijven er immers zorgen bestaan over de rechtsstaat.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the bill approving the EU-Georgia Association Agreement, asking the explanatory memorandum to address Georgia's current political situation, which bears on the agreement's aims. The government's reply declined to add the current situation to the memorandum, arguing it is a static document, but included an update in the reply and committed to informing parliament of developments.
concerns: The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum discuss the current situation in Georgia given the agreement's objectives; the government did not add it to the memorandum but included it in the nader rapport and promised parliament updates.

34142.s: The bill creates a legal basis for implementing the Nagoya Protocol on access to genetic resources and benefit sharing and for enforcing EU regulation 511/2014 in the Netherlands. It lets the Minister of Economic Affairs designate rules by ministerial regulation and general administrative order, grant exemptions, impose administrative fines and immediate temporary measures, and appoint inspectors.
34142.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the Dutch legislature has no room for policy choices where EU regulations are binding, so administrative detail can go to ministerial regulation.
q: By general administrative order, rules are set on the maximum amount of the administrative fine that may be imposed for an offence or categories of offences.
Bij algemene maatregel van bestuur worden regels gesteld over de hoogte van de bestuurlijke boete die voor een overtreding of voor categorieën van overtredingen ten hoogste kan worden opgelegd.
d: designate EU regulation provisions whose breach is prohibited
rules implementing EU regulation provisions without discretion and on submission of applications
rules on access to genetic resources and benefit sharing implementing Nagoya Protocol and EU regulation
minister may grant exemptions from rules under article 2
rules setting maximum administrative fine amounts per violation category
p: The minister may take immediate temporary measures such as seizure, bans on use or transport, and forced return of genetic resources against users, with conditions and restrictions but without prior judicial authorisation.
The minister may impose an order under administrative coercion or a penalty payment to enforce the act.
The minister may impose administrative fines with ceilings set by general administrative order, while serious cases are referred to the public prosecutor.

parties: Asks how the government will enforce the scope limit to newly acquired resources, whether compliance burdens were counted in cost estimates, and the basis for cost and hourly-rate assumptions.
Can the government explain how this will be enforced?
Kan de regering uiteenzetten hoe dat gehandhaafd zal worden?
Asks what the consequences are for compliance when countries require prior consent but do not meet the protocol's conditions, and how breeders' rights relate to commercial varieties.
These members ask the government what the consequences are for compliance with this treaty if countries require prior consent but do not meet these conditions.
Deze leden vragen de regering wat de gevolgen zijn voor de naleving van dit verdrag indien landen wel aangeven dat ze voorafgaande toestemming vereisen, maar niet aan deze voorwaarden voldoen.

Demands a fair, transparent and accessible dispute-settlement mechanism for indigenous peoples and asks how their interests and consent will be heard, and worries about burdens on small businesses and seed banks.
The SP members attach great importance to a fair, transparent and accessible dispute-settlement mechanism for resolving conflicts over genetic material.
De leden van de SP-fractie hechten veel waarde aan een eerlijk, transparant en toegankelijk geschillenbeslechtingsmechanisme voor het oplossen van conflicten over genetisch materiaal.
Asks for independent cost calculations, evaluation of the expected benefits, and clarity on prosecution and liability of companies, while questioning practical enforceability.
Does the government share these members' concerns that implementing the protocol may lead to costs while the benefits of the protocol are uncertain?
Deelt de regering de zorgen van deze leden dat de implementatie van het protocol kan leidden tot kosten onderwijl de baten van het protocol onzeker zijn?
Warns about biopiracy and patents on living material, questions how multinationals and US companies would be covered, and asks for stronger steps toward a broad breeders' exemption.

34160.s: The bill amends the Dutch vocational education act (WEB, and WEB BES for the Caribbean Netherlands) to introduce mandatory electives (keuzedelen) attached to vocational qualifications, with rules on their registration, examination, certificates and the ministerial process for establishing them. It sets out general powers for the Minister to adopt further rules by general administrative order on elective obligations, provision of electives and examinations, while leaving detailed rules to ministerial regulations and lower regulation.
34160.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations as needed to allow flexible, fast development of electives and detailed implementation in lower regulation.
q: A model for a qualification file, a model for an elective and an assessment framework for the qualification structure are also established by ministerial regulation.
Tevens worden bij ministeriële regeling een model voor een kwalificatiedossier, een model voor een keuzedeel en een toetsingskader voor de kwalificatiestructuur vastgesteld.
d: models and criteria for qualification files, electives and their linkage
rules on offer of electives and scope of elective obligation
designation of units and electives carrying certificates
examination and diplomering rules for electives (Examen- en kwalificatiebesluit)
determination of electives and their qualification links for Caribbean Netherlands
p: Minister may set by general administrative order rules on the offer and scope of electives that institutions must provide.
Minister establishes electives and their qualification linkage by ministerial regulation, subject to advice of the Toetsingskamer.

parties: Objects to the centralised approach via SBB and Minister and to keuzedelen not counting toward the diploma; proposes regional accreditation instead.
The members have two fundamental objections to the proposal: the centralised approach on the one hand and the fact that the elective modules do not count toward the diploma on the other.
De leden hebben twee fundamentele bezwaren tegen het voorstel: de gecentraliseerde aanpak enerzijds en het niet meetellen voor het diploma van de keuzedelen anderzijds.
Asks how mandatory keuzedelen serve participants' interests and how students can choose modules matching their career aims; questions on diploma consequences of failing a module.
Can the government further explain how it places the mandatory introduction of elective modules in all mbo programmes in the perspective of the interests of participants in mbo?
Kan de regering nader toelichten hoe zij de verplichte invoering van keuzedelen bij alle mbo-opleidingen plaatst in het perspectief van het belang van de deelnemers in het mbo?
Asks why details of elective modules are left to lower regulation and whether a failing grade on a module still allows passing the diploma.
The D66 members ask the government to explain why the rules on elective modules are elaborated in lower regulation.
De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering toe te lichten waarom de voorschriften betreffende keuzedelen in lagere regelgeving worden uitgewerkt.
Questions whether the bill narrows institutions' room for own programme and asks why the Raad van State proposal allowing reasoned deviation was not adopted.
Can the government justify why it does not want to adopt the Council of State's proposal to be able to deviate from the mandatory elective components with reasons.
Kan de regering motiveren waarom zij niet het voorstel wil overnemen van de Raad van State om gemotiveerd te kunnen afwijken van de verplichte keuze-onderdelen.
Worries the bill removes institutional freedom and regional tailoring, and questions the Toetsingskamer vetting institutions' own elective modules.
Why does the government choose this interference in the freedom of institutions to shape educational content, they ask.
Waarom kiest de regering voor deze inmenging in de vrijheid van instellingen om de onderwijsinhoud vorm te geven, zo vragen zij.
Questions the evidential basis for the problem, the loss of institutional free space, and the lack of statutory safeguards or exceptions for institutions.
They ask for further substantiation of the problems raised, including the number of institutions falling short and the criteria used.
Zij vragen om een nadere onderbouwing van de aangevoerde problematiek, waaronder aantallen instellingen die tekort zouden schieten en de criteria die hiervoor worden gehanteerd.

v.summary: The Raad van State advised that the bill replacing the free space in MBO qualifications with mandatory elective modules should allow schools to deviate with justification, and should address the tension with automatic progression to HBO. The government's reply accepted the advice by clarifying in the explanatory memorandum that schools keep room for profiling and support elements, and by addressing progression, with several redactional changes made.
concerns: The Afdeling questioned whether fully replacing free space with mandatory electives leaves schools enough room to profile themselves, and the government answered by clarifying in the memorandum that profiling and support elements remain possible, without adding a formal deviation power.
The Afdeling advised allowing schools to deviate from mandatory electives on a motivated basis and fixing this in the law, which the government did not adopt.

The Afdeling flagged the tension between non-mandatory electives and HBO admission requirements for automatic progression, and the government addressed this in the memorandum without changing the bill.
Several redactional comments on article wording and the explanatory memorandum were adopted in the revised bill.

34200-X.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Defence and the budget statements of three defence agencies (DTO, DVD, Paresto), approving supplementary budget changes and realisations. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and provides that it takes effect the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The adoption of the budget statements referred to in articles 1 and 2 takes place in thousands of euros.
De vaststelling van de in de artikelen 1 en 2 bedoelde begrotingsstaten geschiedt in duizenden euro's.

34205.s: The bill provides a legal framework for Dutch cooperation with successor mechanisms (restmechanismen) of international criminal tribunals based in the Netherlands, covering surrender, transit, legal assistance and detention of witnesses. It repeals earlier tribunal-specific statutes and lets the government designate covered mechanisms by general administrative order.
34205.j: The memorandum justifies the powers by the need to hand residual tribunal tasks to successor mechanisms and to follow the model of the earlier Yugoslavia statute, with no new substantive changes.
d: designating which restmechanismen the act applies to
p: Any public prosecutor or assistant prosecutor may order provisional arrest on request of the mechanism, with the arrested person brought before a prosecutor and then the court.
Designated Dutch officials may take all measures they consider necessary to secure transported persons and prevent escape.
Witnesses or experts in the Netherlands who ignore a summons may be arrested on the prosecutor's order and placed at the mechanism's disposal.
The court's review of surrender requests is limited to identity and the mechanism's manifest competence, and the decision is immediately enforceable.
Dutch law, and so habeas corpus before Dutch courts, does not apply to detention ordered by the mechanism within premises placed at its disposal.

parties: Asks how the ambition to attract states to the ICC fits with establishing ad hoc tribunals, and how the Joegoslavië Tribunaal can assume appeals before first-instance judgments exist.
How can the government already assume an appeal in these cases, if there is no first-instance judgment yet?
Hoe kan de regering nu al uitgaan van een hoger beroep in deze zaken, als er nog geen uitspraak is in eerste aanleg?
Asks about risks in the assignment of judges to Dutch tribunals and criticises foreign governments' influence over proceedings through appointment and assignment of judges and prosecutors.

These members refer among other things to criticism, for example regarding the appointment of the chief prosecutor at the ICTY, about how foreign governments seek to exert influence on proceedings through the appointment and assignment of judges.

Deze leden verwijzen onder meer naar kritiek, zoals bijvoorbeeld bij de benoeming van de hoofdaanklager bij het Joegoslavië Tribunaal, over de wijze waarop buitenlandse regeringen middels de benoeming en toewijzing van rechters invloed trachten uit te oefenen op proces.
Asks whether residual mechanisms can start new prosecutions of suspects, about immunity of staff, the costs to the Dutch state, and the scope of residual mechanisms' tasks.
Do the staff of a residual mechanism enjoy immunity?
Genieten de medewerkers van een Restmechanisme immuniteit?

34232.s: The bill amends the Dutch Financial Supervision Act (Wft) and related laws to implement EU Directive 2013/50/EU on transparency requirements for issuers of securities, including new reporting on payments to governments, longer retention periods, higher maximum fines for the AFM, and clarifications on home member state determination. It also amends Book 2 of the Civil Code and the Wet toezicht financiële verslaggeving to give the AFM power to petition the Enterprise Chamber to order compliance with the payments-to-governments report.
34232.j: The memorandum justifies the delegation by stating that the detailed content requirements are placed in a general administrative order so rules can be adjusted quickly to changes.
q: The advantage of placing these rules in a decree is that changes can be responded to quickly.
Het voordeel van het neerleggen van deze regels in een besluit is dat er snel op wijzigingen kan worden ingespeeld.
d: content and filing of payments-to-governments report
p: Raises the maximum administrative fine the AFM may impose on legal persons for serious violations to EUR 10 million or 5% of net turnover, subject to supervisory fine guidelines.
Allows the AFM to issue a public warning as an alternative for certain violations of disclosure rules.

parties: Asks why the Dutch 3% notification threshold deviates from the directive's 5%, and what subdelegation and further rules by AMvB or ministerial regulation will contain.
What is the reason that it is necessary in the Netherlands to set this threshold lower?
Wat is de reden dat het in Nederland noodzakelijk is om deze drempel lager vast te stellen?
Supports reporting of payments to governments for transparency and accountability, and asks whether quarterly reporting abolition will reduce short-term focus.
This increases transparency and stimulates good governance and accountability in resource-rich countries.
Dit vergroot de transparantie en stimuleert goed bestuur en accountability in grondstofrijke landen.
Asks why the regulatory content of the payments report is delegated by a basis in the act rather than set in statute, and why a €100,000 reporting threshold applies.
Article 5:25w paragraph 2 includes a legal basis to set rules on the content of the report of payments to governments.
In artikel 5:25w lid 2 wordt een grondslag opgenomen om regels te stellen over de inhoud van het verslag van betalingen aan overheden.
Asks for a response to Eumedion's view that the payments report could be part of the annual report and asks why 3% was chosen over 5%.
The CDA members ask the government to respond to Eumedion's comment that the report on payments to governments could better be part of the annual report than a separate report.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen de regering om een reactie op het commentaar van Eumedion, waarin wordt aangegeven dat het verslag over betalingen aan overheden beter onderdeel van het jaarverslag kan zijn dan een apart verslag.
Asks why the administrative fine maximum is set at €10 million or 5% of turnover, and why the cap is €4 million, raising sanction and proportionality questions.
The PVV members want to know why specifically the amount of €10 million or 5% of total annual turnover was chosen, where the maximum is set at €4 million.
De leden van de PVV-fractie willen weten waarom specifiek voor de hoogte van € 10 mln. of 5% van de totale jaaromzet, waar het maximum is gesteld op € 4 mln., is gekozen.
Asks whether the supervisor may reduce fines that would be unreasonable in specific cases and how unequal treatment between market parties is prevented.
ask whether it is correct that the supervisor has the possibility to reduce a fine if it would be unreasonable in specific cases
vragen of het klopt dat de toezichthouder de mogelijkheid heeft om een boete te verlagen, mocht deze in specifieke gevallen onredelijk uitvallen

34241.s: The bill approves the 2015 tripartite treaty between Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg on integrating airspace security against non-military aircraft (renegades) for the European part of the Netherlands. The treaty lets sending states use force, up to lethal force except for Luxembourg, in receiving states' airspace under transferred tactical control, and disputes are resolved only by negotiation between parties.
34241.j: The memorandum justifies the treaty as necessary for effective joint air defence and for allocating costs proportionately, without addressing the expanded use-of-force powers or the exclusion of judicial review in depth.
p: The treaty creates a legal basis for sending states to use force, up to lethal force, in another state's airspace under transferred tactical control, a power that is shifted outside national judicial review.
Artikel XII en XIII (memorie van toelichting)
Disputes arising from implementation or interpretation of the treaty may not be submitted to any national or international court or third party, leaving negotiation as the only means of resolution.

parties: Asks about the rationale and consequences of Luxembourg excluding lethal force, the rotation arrangement and cost sharing, and whether lethal force could be used in French airspace in exceptional cases.

They ask what the motivation behind this exception is and what the consequences are in situations above Luxembourg where lethal force would have been used had the same situation occurred above Belgium or the Netherlands.

Zij vragen wat de motivatie achter deze uitzondering is en wat de consequenties van deze uitzondering zijn in die situaties boven Luxemburg, waarbij wel tot dodelijk geweld zou zijn overgegaan indien dezelfde situatie zich zou hebben voorgedaan boven België of Nederland.

Warns that the treaty must not preclude discussion of the number of fighter aircraft to be acquired, citing Court of Audit criticism, and questions whether Belgium will meet its treaty obligations amid budget cuts.

According to these members, the proposed treaty with Belgium, and the advantages this cooperation brings, must not stand in the way of the necessary discussion about the future number of fighter aircraft to be acquired.

Het voorgenomen verdrag met België – en de voordelen die dit samenwerkingsverband oplevert – mag volgens deze leden niet in de weg staan aan de noodzakelijke discussie over het toekomstige aantal te verwerven jachtvliegtuigen.

Asks about response times, operating bases, French aircraft powers and sovereignty in cross-border action, and how command and red card holder authority are allocated between renegade tasks and NATO QRA.
Which powers can the French aircraft exercise and which measures can they take against renegade aircraft flying over Belgian and/or Dutch airspace, the members of the PVV faction ask.</evidence_en>

Welke bevoegdheden kunnen de Franse toestellen uitoefenen en welke maatregelen kunnen zij nemen tegen renegade-toestellen die vliegen boven het Belgische en/of Nederlandse luchtruim, zo vragen de leden van de PVV-fractie.

Asks for the practical and theoretical consequences of Luxembourg excluding lethal force and whether Netherlands is compensated, and suggests delaying entry into force until arrangements with France are settled.
If not, the members consider it advisable to let the treaty enter into force only once these talks have been concluded and a solution has been reached.
Zo nee, dan achten de genoemde leden het raadzaam om het voorliggende verdrag pas in werking te laten treden als deze gesprekken zijn afgerond en er een oplossing is.

34304.s: The bill replaces existing wage-cost premium discounts for older and disabled workers with a system of wage-cost advantages (loonkostenvoordelen) paid by the tax authority after the year, based on data already held by government, and introduces a low-income employer advantage. It also amends the Wet financiering sociale verzekeringen and sets transitional rules, sanctions, and an evaluation duty.
34304.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated power to adjust amounts as a way to keep the budgetary cost of the benefits in line with forecasts, given that payment happens only after the year ends.
q: To achieve as much balance as possible between the budgeted amounts for the benefits and actual use, article 6.1 includes a delegation power.

Teneinde zo veel mogelijk evenwicht te bereiken tussen de in de rijksbegroting opgenomen bedragen voor de in de Wtl opgenomen tegemoetkomingen en het feitelijke gebruik wordt in artikel 6.1 een delegatiebevoegdheid opgenomen
d: rules on validity of target-group declaration
conditions on proof of foreign benefit entitlement
rules on validity of target-group declaration (disabled workers)
conditions on proof of foreign benefit entitlement
rules on validity of target-group declaration (banenafspraak)
rules on validity of target-group declaration (reintegration)
adjusting income band amounts in line with minimum wage indexation
data to be stated on the decision
raising or lowering benefit amounts to match budget use
p: Allows the minister, by ministerial regulation, to raise or lower the statutory benefit amounts in the act to match budget use, without parliamentary approval of the new amounts.
Lets the inspector revise granted benefits against the employer up to five years later, subject to appeal under the general tax act.
Empowers the inspector to impose administrative fines on employers for incorrect claims or data, with appeal available.

parties: Asks about the 24-hour weekly minimum threshold and its effect on temporary agency workers, and whether the government will reject proposals to raise or abolish the youth minimum wage.
The members of the VVD faction have taken note of the bill. They have a few questions.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van het wetsvoorstel. Zij hebben enkele vragen.
Supports the bill's goals and the low-income instrument, while asking about the effects of paying the allowance afterwards and the grenseffecten above 120% of the minimum wage.
The members of the PvdA faction support the objectives of the Wet Tegemoetkomingen Loondomein (WTL).
De leden van de fractie van de PvdA ondersteunen de doelstellingen van de Wet Tegemoetkomingen Loondomein (WTL).
Asks how the Belastingdienst and UWV will divide tasks in handling objections and appeals, and why the two bills are not introduced together.
The members of the SP faction wonder how exactly the Belastingdienst and the UWV will cooperate in implementing the revision of objection and appeal procedures?
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen zich af hoe de Belastingdienst en het UWV precies gaan samenwerken op de uitvoering van de herziening bij bezwaar en beroep?

Doubts the LIV is targeted, warns of large deadweight loss and windfalls for employers, questions implementability given the UWV-Belastingdienst cooperation risk, and asks whether the Belastingdienst should pay out money to firms.
Yet these members seriously question the chosen design, in particular the low-income advantage."
Toch plaatsen deze leden serieuze vraagtekens bij de gekozen vormgeving en dan met name bij het lage-inkomensvoordeel.
Supports the LIV and even a larger budget, but asks for consultation of the Tweede Kamer on adjusting the allowance by ministerial regulation and suggests a voorhangprocedure.
What is the government's position on a prior-submission procedure when adjusting the level of the allowance?
Hoe staat de regering tegenover een voorhangprocedure bij het aanpassen van de hoogte van de tegemoetkoming?
Asks for clarification of the sectors and wage scales affected, the conversion of existing rights, and the effects of prefinancing by employers.
These members ask for further explanation of the delimitation of the group of employees with a wage between 100% and 120% of the statutory minimum wage to which the low-income advantage will apply.

De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie vragen om een nadere toelichting op afbakening van de groep van werknemers met een loon tussen 100% en 120% van het wettelijk minimumloon waarvoor het lage inkomensvoordeel zal gaan gelden.
Asks whether the measures mirror the afdrachtvermindering lage lonen abolished in 2006 for lack of effectiveness, and whether the downward adjustment is purely budgetary.
The members of the PVV faction ask whether it is correct that the measures in this bill are the equivalent of the afdrachtvermindering lage lonen introduced in 1996 and abolished in 2006.
De leden van de fractie van de PVV vragen of het klopt dat de maatregelen van in dit wetsvoorstel het evenbeeld zijn van de in 1996 ingevoerde en in 2006 afgeschafte afdrachtvermindering lage lonen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises proceeding with the Wet tegemoetkomingen loondomein but asks for better justification on the effectiveness of wage subsidies (not embedded in broader labour market reform), on whether the Toetsingskader Belastinguitgaven was applied, and on how the budget impact (EUR 786 million versus EUR 500 million) is accounted for in the Rijksbegroting. The government's reply largely rejects the belastinguitgave qualification, supplements the memorie van toelichting on effectiveness and budget accounting, and adds transitional rules discussion for the premievrijstelling marginale arbeid.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the effectiveness of wage measures not embedded in fundamental labour market reform and of the generic LIV, which risks deadweight and displacement effects.

The Afdeling considers the LIV and LKV to be belastinguitgaven requiring use of the Toetsingskader Belastinguitgaven; the government rejects this qualification because the benefits are not deducted from taxes or premiums.

The explanation of the budgetary impact and how it is accounted for in the Rijksbegroting was unclear; the government clarifies the LKV is budget-neutral and the EUR 500 million relates only to the LIV.

The Afdeling asks whether persons currently benefiting from the premievrijstelling marginale arbeid are compensated; the government explains the transition period through 2018 but the reply does not address compensation directly.

34322.s: The bill implements EU Directive 2014/91/EU amending the UCITS rules on depositaries, remuneration and sanctions into the Dutch Wft, introducing a licensing requirement for depositaries, new depositary duties, liability and reporting rules, and a power for the AFM to suspend fund subscriptions and redemptions. It also allows the AFM to ban individuals from holding certain functions at financial firms and raises maximum fines.
34322.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new powers by the need to implement the directive's requirements and align with existing enforcement tools in other EU legislation.
q: By now this sanction has become a usual part of the enforcement toolkit in European directives and regulations.
Inmiddels is deze sanctie een gebruikelijk onderdeel van het handhavingsinstrumentarium in Europese richtlijnen en verordeningen geworden.
d: AFM order to suspend subscriptions, redemptions or repurchases of fund units
exemption from depositary licensing requirement for certain closed-end funds
rules on independence of depositary and content of depositary agreement
rules on third-country depositaries and entities that may act as depositary
conditions under which financial instruments are deemed lost for depositary liability
liability of depositary where functions are delegated to third countries
content and submission of annual accounts and reports of depositaries
irregularities in master UCITS that must be reported
information-exchange agreement between depositaries of master and feeder UCITS
AFM exemption from depositary reporting obligations on request
fee amounts for AFM licensing and supervision of depositaries
p: Supervisors may ban individuals from holding functions at financial firms for up to one year, renewable, or indefinitely in certain repeat cases, limited to serious offences.
The AFM may order fund managers to suspend subscriptions and redemptions in the general or unitholders' interest.
Depositaries are made strictly liable for loss of custodied instruments, which strengthens investor protection.

parties: Asks how remuneration rules will be detailed by the AFM in lower regulation and why depositaries' liability cannot be limited or excluded.
Which matters concerning remuneration does the Minister want to regulate in this lower regulation, ask the members of the VVD fractie.
Welke zaken omtrent beloningen wil de Minister regelen in deze lagere regelgeving, vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Asks how the Chamber will be informed about the AFM's detailed remuneration rules.
In what way will the Chamber be informed about the detailed elaboration of the remuneration rules by the AFM?
Op welke wijze wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd over de nadere uitwerking van de beloningsregels door de AFM?
Supports remuneration regulation in principle but asks why the remuneration rules are not fixed directly in legislation as was done for bank bonuses.
In this regard these members ask why it was not chosen to lay down the remuneration provisions directly in legislation, as was also done for bank bonuses.
Daarbij vragen deze leden waarom er niet gekozen om de beloningsvoorschriften meteen in wetgeving vast te leggen, zoals dat ook bij bonussen met banken is gebeurd?
Asks why remuneration rules are set in lower regulation and wants the Chamber informed in advance of what it will contain to avoid surprises.
The members of the PVV fractie would like to know in advance what will be included in this regulation.
De leden van de PVV-fractie zouden graag van te voren willen weten wat er in deze regelgeving komt te staan.
Asks for examples of when the supervisor may suspend subscriptions, limits on subdelegation of depositary tasks, and what counts as an external event exempting liability.
However, the explanatory memorandum does not state when such situations occur.
De toelichting vermeldt echter niet wanneer van dergelijke situaties sprake is.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised sending the Wft implementation bill for the UCITS depositary, remuneration and sanctions directive to parliament after amendments: clarifying the new suspension power of the supervisor, removing the ECB power provision from article 1:87, adding a licensing requirement for depositaries, and clarifying the sanctions for depositary liability. The Minister's nader rapport reports that the bill was amended on all these points, including adding article 4:62n as a licensing requirement and removing the fine or penalty for breach of article 4:62p since nullity already applies.
concerns: The supervisor's new power to suspend subscriptions, redemptions or repurchases lacked clarity on when it applies, so the explanatory memorandum was expanded with exceptional and urgent situations.

Article 1:87 wrongly suggested the Dutch legislature could assign powers to EU institutions such as the ECB, so the wording and explanation were amended to reflect that the ECB's power derives from EU regulation.
Article 4:62n on permissible depositaries was not listed as a licensing requirement, so it was added to articles 2:67 and 2:69 and the related article 2:68.
Adding a fine or periodic penalty for breaching the non-exclusion of depositary liability was pointless given the nullity sanction, so the bill was changed accordingly.
Redactional comments on the draft text were adopted and technical amendments were made.

34331.s: The bill amends the Dutch Caribbean study finance act (WSF BES) and several related laws to fix implementation problems in student finance, such as eligibility, grant and repayment rules, and aligns transitional provisions for education housing with a date to be set by royal decree. It also makes technical changes to the Wet studiefinanciering 2000 and sets its entry into force by royal decree.
34331.j: The memorandum justifies the changes by pointing to unintended gaps in the act and the need to align rules with actual implementation practice and to fix the transitional deadline.
q: Meanwhile the costs of living in that intervening period do continue.
Dit terwijl de kosten van levensonderhoud in die tussenliggende periode wel doorlopen.
d: entry into force of articles by royal decree
date when personal number BES provisions take effect, set by royal decree
payment rhythm of study finance different from monthly, depending on local situation
end date of housing transitional regime set by royal decree instead of 2017
p: Extends the period in which the executive may revise student finance decisions and extends the revision grounds, including for errors in the amount, form and duration of the grant.
Postpones application of statutory provisions on the personal number BES to a date set by royal decree, outside parliamentary timing.
Allows a ministerial regulation to set a payment schedule other than monthly for study finance.

parties: Notes the amendments and has no further questions or remarks.
The VVD members have taken note of the amendment of, among other things, the Wet studiefinanciering BES and have no reason for further questions or remarks.
De leden van de VVD-fractie hebben kennisgenomen van de aanpassing van onder meer de Wet studiefinanciering BES en hebben geen reden tot verdere vragen of opmerkingen.
Asks whether the law risks postponing the deadline for renewing education housing and what the causes of the missed deadline are, and asks for a new date.
The PvdA members ask about education housing whether this law risks postponing the leverage needed to realise renewal and improvement of education housing in time.

De leden van PvdA-fractie vragen omtrent de onderwijshuisvesting of deze wet er niet voor zorgt dat het drukmiddel om vernieuwing en verbetering van onderwijshuisvesting tijdig te realiseren, op de lange baan geschoven dreigt te worden.
Asks for a breakdown of students keeping travel products after expiry, whether the fine increase is gradual, and the revenue of the fine, seeking detailed justification from the government.
Can the government prepare an overview, broken down by month after the expiry of the travel entitlement, of the number of persons who kept their student travel product running?
Kan de regering een overzicht, uitgesplitst per maand na het verloop van het reisrecht, opstellen met de aantallen personen die hun studentenreisproduct hebben laten doorlopen?

34403.s: The bill temporarily allows housing associations (toegelaten instellingen) to extend their work area to provide services and housing-related works for refugee permit holders (vergunninghouders), with ministerial permission for up to ten years. It also sets transitional rules so permissions granted under the earlier experimental article remain valid until they expire.
34403.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers by the need to house permit holders quickly, following an earlier experimental policy rule and consultation feedback.
q: Our Minister may grant housing associations, their wholly owned affiliated companies and joint ventures permission to also carry out the following activities in addition to those in article 45, paragraph 2.

Onze Minister kan toegelaten instellingen, de met hen verbonden ondernemingen van welke zij de enige aandeelhoudster zijn en de samenwerkingsvennootschappen toestemming verlenen om, naast de in artikel 45, tweede lid, genoemde werkzaamheden tevens de volgende werkzaamheden te verrichten
d: conditions and cases for ministerial permission to housing associations
ministerial permission for extended work area up to ten years
p: The minister may grant housing associations permission to undertake new activities for third parties, limited to housing permit holders and a maximum of ten years.

parties: Asks whether the bill is sufficiently coherent with related policy, whether it conflicts with EU law on housing association activities, and whether the market test should be anchored in the statute.
Does the government consider that coherence in the present bill is sufficiently anchored?
Acht de regering die samenhang in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel voldoende verankerd?
Supports rapid expansion of the scope given urgency, but asks about the cost and delay of the market test and how timely evaluation or expiry of the extension will be ensured.
The PvdA members support the rapid extension of the operating scope of housing associations, because the urgency is high.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie steunen de snelle uitbreiding van het werkgebied van toegelaten instellingen, omdat de urgentie hoog is.

Demands analyses and figures on waiting times and placements, questions why a temporary statutory change rather than the experiment policy rule, who determines the temporariness, and why a market test is justified.
The SP members urgently request an analysis of waiting and search times for tenants and housing seekers, as these members have already requested it many times.
De leden van de SP-fractie vragen met een klem om een analyse van de wacht- en zoektijden voor huurders en woningzoekenden omdat deze leden al veelvuldig hierom hebben verzocht.
Worries that housing permit-holders could displace regular housing seekers on waiting lists and asks for a sound projection and explicit safeguards against displacement.
A clear substantiation of that principle is essential and is therefore missing in the present bill.
Een heldere onderbouwing van dat uitgangspunt is essentieel en wordt daarom gemist bij het voorliggende wetsvoorstel.
Surprised at removing legal obstacles in the Housing Act and believes closing borders is the better solution to the asylum problem.
Furthermore, these members are of the opinion that closing the borders is the best solution to the asylum problem.
Verder zijn deze leden van mening het sluiten van de grenzen de beste oplossing is voor het asielprobleem.
Asks about the effect on dispersal and integration of permit-holders, the future use of converted office buildings, and the financial meaning of cost-covering rental of state property.
These members believe that good dispersal of permit-holders can greatly benefit integration.
Deze leden menen dat een goede spreiding van vergunninghouders de integratie zeer ten goede kan komen.
Asks which criteria the Autoriteit woningcorporaties may use for a directive on housing allocation, whether the investment cap is needed given its general powers, and how the market test works.
It can happen that at a later stage a lower percentage of dwellings is let to permit-holders.
Het kan voorkomen dat in een later stadium een lager percentage woningen aan vergunninghouders wordt verhuurd.
Asks why the priority rule in the Housing Act is not amended, why the term huisvesting is undefined, and why the scheme is not reviewed periodically every five years instead of re-legislating.
These members ask why no obligation was chosen to review every five years whether the proposed scheme is still needed.
Deze leden vragen waarom niet gekozen is voor een verplichting om de elke vijf jaar te toetsen of nog steeds behoefte bestaat aan de voorgestelde regeling.

Asks whether housing associations should provide the proposed services at all, why a light market test is used, how waiting lists are protected, and how the independence of the Autoriteit woningcorporaties is guaranteed.

Finally, member Van Vliet asks how the government guarantees the independence of the Autoriteit woningcorporaties when it interferes in the implementation of the market test and the other aspects covered by this bill.

Tenslotte vraagt het lid Van Vliet zich af hoe de regering de onafhankelijkheid van de Autoriteit woningcorporaties waarborgt wanneer zij zich bemoeit met de invulling van de markttoets en de andere facetten die dit wetsvoorstel beslaan.

34412.s: The bill restricts the use of the names universiteit and hogeschool, limits who may award degrees and titles, and requires institutions for higher education to promote social responsibility, with fines imposed by the Inspectorate of Education on behalf of the Minister. It also amends the Higher Education Act, the Education Inspection Act and the Criminal Code accordingly.
34412.j: The memorandum justifies the ministerial and inspectorate powers by the need for efficient, specialist enforcement against misleading names and degrees, and notes that objection and appeal remain available.
q: It is not intended that there will be systematic government checks on whether the information provided in connection with awarding foreign degrees is correct.
Het is niet de bedoeling dat er stelselmatige controle van overheidswege komt of de informatie die wordt gegeven in verband met de verlening van buitenlandse graden, klopt.
d: Minister may allow foreign branch campuses from non-EEA countries to use the name universiteit under criteria in a ministerial regulation
Minister may allow foreign branch campuses from non-EEA countries to use the name hogeschool under criteria in a ministerial regulation
Minister designates foreign programmes and examinations whose graduates may use Dutch titles
Minister designates foreign universities whose doctorate holders may use the title doctor
Detailed rules on statutory tuition entitlement for education and health care programmes, to be set in the Uitvoeringsbesluit WHW 2008
p: The Minister may impose administrative fines on institutions and persons who unlawfully award degrees or use protected names, with fine levels capped by statute and proportionality required.
Artikel II (Wet op het onderwijstoezicht, artikel 3 lid 3 sub e)
The Inspectorate of Education, acting on behalf of the Minister, is empowered to impose administrative fines, with objection and appeal open against the decision.

Institutions must promote social responsibility, including refraining from discriminatory conduct by their representatives; non-compliance can lead to loss of degree-awarding status, with the memorandum noting that rights are withdrawn only where proportionate.

parties: Asks for justification of the need for name protection, concrete examples of institutions affected, and treatment of exceptions such as the Johan Cruyff University.
Can the government give concrete examples of institutions that under the new rules may no longer present themselves as university or university of applied sciences?
Kan de regering concrete voorbeelden noemen van instellingen die zich onder de nieuwe regels niet meer mogen presenteren als universiteit of hogeschool?

Supports protecting degree trust and names, but questions whether existing law is insufficient, what sanctions apply to non-subsidised institutions, and how discrimination is judged without infringing academic and free-speech rights.
The members can therefore agree with rules to create clarity for students, institutions and employers and to protect the good name of our higher education.
De leden kunnen zich dan ook vinden in regels om hierin duidelijkheid te creëren voor studenten, instellingen en werkgevers en de goede naam van ons hoger onderwijs te beschermen.

Supports better protection of names and degrees but asks about the English term 'university of applied science' possibly misleading foreign students, and whether discriminatory statements should be handled through criminal rather than administrative law.
Does the nature of the offence not fit criminal law rather than administrative law?
Past de aard van de overtreding niet veeleer bij het strafrecht, dan bij het bestuursrecht?
Questions the necessity of the bill and notes the Raad van State's criticism that the discrimination provision crosses the constitutional freedom of education and should be left to criminal judges.

The D66 members ask the government to respond to the Council of State's criticism that this proposal crosses a constitutional limit, namely freedom of education, and that assessment of discriminatory expressions should be left to the criminal judge.

De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering in te gaan op de kritiek van de Raad van State dat dit voorstel een grondwettelijke grens overschrijdt, namelijk de vrijheid van onderwijs, en dat beoordeling van uitingen van discriminatie overgelaten moeten worden aan de strafrechter.

Stresses the constitutional freedom of institutions and questions whether the ministerial powers to withdraw rights and impose funding sanctions, and the vague notion of social responsibility awareness, are proportionate.
Government intervention is only justified when it is necessary to guarantee the soundness of education.
Overheidsingrijpen is slechts gerechtvaardigd, wanneer dit noodzakelijk is om de deugdelijkheid van het onderwijs te garanderen.

Warns that restrictions on fundamental freedoms require restraint, that the bill is one-sided and creates legal uncertainty by reducing the state-principles check to an anti-discrimination rule, and questions the constitutional basis of article 23.
The SGP members emphasise that infringements on fundamental freedoms require particular restraint and care.
De leden van de SGP-fractie benadrukken dat inbreuken op fundamentele vrijheden bijzondere terughoudendheid en zorgvuldigheid vereisen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised not to send the bill to the Tweede Kamer until its remarks were taken into account, mainly questioning the need and added value of protecting the names 'universiteit' and 'hogeschool', the proportionality of raising the administrative fine to the sixth category, and the power to deprive institutions of rights over discrimination. The government reply largely defends the bill, accepts some clarifications in the explanatory memorandum and moves the non-discrimination provision from art. 6.10 to art. 1.3(5), but keeps the core proposals.
concerns: The Afdeling doubts the necessity and added value of protecting the names universiteit and hogeschool given existing accreditation and CROHO rules; the government maintains that norms are needed and adds a more detailed justification in the general part.

The Afdeling advises reconsidering the administrative fine and ensuring proportionality, since raising the maximum from the lowest to the sixth category is a factor 2,000 increase; the government keeps the fine but adds further justification in the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling argues that the power to deprive institutions of rights for discriminatory conduct crosses the constitutional freedom of education and advises dropping it; the government keeps the sanction but sharpens the explanation and moves the duty to art. 1.3(5).

The Afdeling notes that prosecuting discriminatory statements is a task for the public prosecutor rather than the Minister, and the government replies that the institution's sanction is separate from criminal proceedings.

The Afdeling questions the different treatment of branches of institutions from EEA and non-EEA countries and the criterion of belonging to the world top; the government justifies the distinction by free movement of services and the Bologna process and adds explanation on world-top institutions.
The Afdeling notes the explanatory memorandum's passage on discrimination refers to the wrong article; the government corrects the text and removes co-signature by the Minister of Economic Affairs.

34475-J.s: This Slotwet (closing budget act) amends the 2015 budget statement of the Deltafonds, adjusting appropriations and realised figures across its articles. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We, with the joint consultation of the States General, have found and resolved, as We find and resolve by this: Article 1 The budget statement of the Deltafonds for the year 2015 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this act.

Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan, gelijk Wij goedvinden en verstaan bij deze: Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Deltafonds voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd

34485-I.s: The bill amends the 2016 budget statement of the Royal Household (budget item I) by a first supplementary budget, raising commitments and expenditure by EUR 762 thousand and receipts by EUR 39 thousand. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and fixes entry into force as 1 June 2016 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Amendment of the budget statement belonging to the budget of the King (I) for 2016 (First supplementary budget)
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat behorende bij de begroting van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2016 (Eerste suppletoire begroting)

34485-XVIII.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2016 budget statements for the Ministry of Housing and Central Government Services (XVIII) and for the government agencies, adjusting appropriations and cash flows in thousands of euros. It sets the entry-into-force date of 1 June 2016 and includes the merger of the real estate agencies into the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf.
34485-XVIII.j: The memorandum explains that the budget changes implement the merger of the agencies into the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf after the prescribed pre-consultation procedure, and mentions a general administrative order for housing allowance shortfalls, without new executive powers.
q: After the prescribed pre-consultation procedure, the merger is now a reality.
Na de voorgeschreven voorhangprocedure is de fusie nu werkelijkheid.

34845-I.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning), the second supplementary budget, adding expenditure and budget moves in thousands of euros across the non-policy articles. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, no new executive powers and no oversight changes, and the explanatory memorandum is absent.
q: The budget statement of the Royal Household for 2017 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this act.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van de begroting van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2017 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34845-XVIII.s: This bill amends the 2017 budget statements for the Ministry of Housing and Central Government Affairs (Wonen en Rijksdienst) and for the government agencies, approving second supplementary budget changes in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 December 2017 or retroactively from that date if published later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of Housing and Central Government Affairs
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat

35006.s: The bill adds Article 11a to the Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij, allowing the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality to impose an order under administrative enforcement (last onder bestuursdwang) to enforce the Act. The explanatory memorandum says this complements existing criminal sanctions and enables preventive administrative action.
35006.j: The memorandum justifies the new power by arguing that criminal sanctions alone cannot end ongoing violations, so administrative restorative sanctions are needed, and that the chosen instruments are proportionate and effective.
q: With this bill the Minister is given the power to impose administrative restorative sanctions in the form of an order under administrative enforcement or an order subject to a penalty payment.
Met dit wetsvoorstel krijgt de Minister de bevoegdheid om bestuursrechtelijke herstelsancties op te leggen in de vorm van een last onder bestuursdwang of een last onder dwangsom.
p: The Minister gains power to impose administrative enforcement orders on fur-farm operators, supplementing existing criminal enforcement, with the memorandum invoking proportionality and reference to general administrative law (Awb).

parties: Asks the government to justify why the new enforcement instruments are necessary and why they were not included earlier, and raises the personal hardship caused by the ban.
Can the government justify why this amendment is necessary? Why were these instruments not included earlier, ask the members of the VVD faction.
Kan de regering motiveren waarom deze wijziging van wet noodzakelijk is? Waarom zijn deze instrumenten niet eerder meegenomen, zo vragen de leden van de VVD-fractie.
Asks whether the additional sanctions are truly needed for enforcement and how often they could have been applied since the law took effect.
To what extent are the proposed additional sanctions truly necessary to achieve enforcement of the law?
In hoeverre zijn de voorliggende extra sancties echt nodig om handhaving van de wet te bewerkstelligen?

Supports effective enforcement but asks how due care is ensured in administrative procedures, given the safeguards in criminal law, and asks for clarity on discretion over dwangsom amounts and the relation to criminal sanctions.
However, these members see that criminal law contains sufficient safeguards for a careful procedure.
Wel zien deze leden dat er in het strafrecht voldoende waarborgen zitten ten behoeve van een zorgvuldige procedure.
Welcomes the amendment as overdue and has no further questions.
They are of the view that this amendment was already necessary since the introduction of the fur farming ban and are therefore pleased that it has finally come.
Zij zijn van mening dat deze wetswijzing al nodig was sinds de invoering van het verbod op de pelsdierhouderij en zijn dan ook verheugd dat het er eindelijk van is gekomen.
Asks in which situations the minister will use an order under administrative coercion versus a dwangsom, what criteria set the amount of a dwangsom, and how often current sanctions fell short.
Which criteria are applied when determining the amount of a dwangsom?
Welke criteria worden gehanteerd bij het bepalen van de hoogte van een dwangsom?

35015.s: The bill amends the Dutch Pensioenwet and Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling on premium payment timing, pension variation after AOW-age increases, small pension buy-outs and waardeoverdracht, and extends works-council information rights on pensions in the Wet op de ondernemingsraden. It also introduces a temporary small-pension buy-out rule and makes the regulator able to share participant data.
35015.j: The memorandum justifies narrowing the oversight bodies' role by saying the transfers are mandatory under the Wet waarde overdracht klein pensioen and that the change has negligible regulatory burden.
q: Under the current provisions of the Pensioenwet and the Wvb, the accountability and beneficiaries bodies have an advice or approval right over full or partial transfer of the pension fund's obligations.

Het verantwoordings- en belanghebbendenorgaan hebben op grond van de huidige bepalingen in de Pensioenwet en de Wet verplichte beroepspensioenregeling (Wvb) een advies- of goedkeuringsrecht bij gehele of gedeeltelijke overdracht van de verplichtingen van het pensioenfonds.
p: Artikel I, onderdeel I; Artikel II, onderdeel I
Pension fund boards decide on small-pension transfers, with the supervisory and accountability bodies' approval or advice right narrowed to fund policy rather than individual transfers.

parties: Asks how pension funds will be able to choose between buying out or transferring very small pensions and what the administrative cost of adjusting automated processes will be.
Can pension funds choose whether to buy out these pensions or transfer them?
Kunnen pensioenfondsen kiezen of zij deze pensioenen afkopen of overdragen?

Raises the GDPR compliance and risks of DNB data supply and asks whether student orphans should have to re-declare their status each year, and questions outsourcing (fiduciary management) without transfer of responsibility.
They are of the view that outsourcing of work should be possible for pension administrators, but that this must not mean that the associated responsibilities also transfer.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat het uitbesteden van werkzaamheden mogelijk moet zijn voor pensioenuitvoerders, maar dat dit niet mag betekenen dat er ook bijbehorende verantwoordelijkheden over gaan.
Asks what powers participants have to enforce a buy-out at their fund and whether consent is ensured for sharing student data from DUO with pension administrators.
What possibilities does the government see to ensure that participants who wish to have their very small pension bought out can also enforce this against their pension fund?
Welke mogelijkheden ziet de regering om er voor te zorgen dat deelnemers die graag hun heel kleine pensioen willen laten afkopen dit ook kunnen afdwingen bij hun pensioenfonds?
Supports the bill's measures on works-council participation and the overbruggingspensioen, and asks how the regret-option scheme is communicated to participants.
How has the possibility of the regret-option scheme been communicated to participants?
Hoe is de mogelijkheid van de spijtoptantenregeling gecommuniceerd naar de deelnemers?

35033.s: The bill replaces the small-business VAT scheme (KOR) with a turnover-based exemption for entrepreneurs with turnover up to EUR 20,000, extending it to non-natural persons and adjusting related VAT rules. Implementing details, including notification procedures, thresholds and adjustment rules, are left largely to ministerial regulation.
35033.j: The memorandum justifies the detailed ministerial rules as needed to handle VAT adjustments and transition when the scheme changes, without extended reasoning on the delegation.
q: Further rules on the application of this article may be laid down by ministerial regulation.
Bij ministeriële regeling kunnen nadere regels worden gesteld inzake de toepassing van dit artikel.
d: further rules on application of the small-business exemption
Artikel 11, lid 1, onderdeel b, ten vijfde
conditions for letting immovable property with VAT option
tax inspector prescribes notification manner and may refuse exemption by binding decision
inspector prescribes notification manner and may refuse transitional application
p: Artikel 25, lid 6 and Artikel III, lid 1
The inspector may by appealable decision refuse an entrepreneur the exemption if compliance is judged unlikely, giving the tax administration discretion over access to the scheme.

parties: Asks for justification of the EUR 20,000 threshold, budgetary effects of changing thresholds, transition rules and administrative burden for entrepreneurs.
On the basis of what information and arguments was the EUR 20,000 turnover threshold chosen?
Op basis van welke informatie en of argumenten is de grens van € 20.000 omzet gekozen?
Asks technical questions on VAT transparency on invoices, cross-border effects, the three-year option period, the EUR 500 revision threshold and treatment of fiscal unities.
Can the government confirm this observation and confirm that these effects will not occur under the proposed modernised KOR?
Kan de regering deze constatering beamen en bevestigen dat deze effecten niet optreden bij de voorgestelde gemoderniseerde KOR?
Asks why the threshold and three-year commitment period were chosen and requests regular updates if budgetary effects deviate from the estimate.
These members ask the government to regularly inform the House when the budgetary effects turn out to deviate from the estimate.
Deze leden vragen de regering om de Kamer regelmatig te informeren wanneer de budgettaire gevolgen blijken af te wijken van de raming.
Asks why the measure was delayed since 2011 and how the government will monitor tax avoidance and splitting of businesses to stay under the threshold.
How will the government monitor whether tax is not being evaded?
Hoe gaat de regering monitoren of er geen belasting wordt ontweken?
Asks about the basis for the threshold, the exclusion of new vehicles, the open-ended duration of the choice and the justification for behavioural estimates.
The members ask for a defined fixed period.
De leden vragen om een afgebakende bepaalde tijd.
Asks for the reason behind the relatively low threshold, how agricultural entrepreneurs were considered after the farmers' scheme was abolished, and a breakdown of expected uptake.
Is this only because the scheme is thereby budget-neutral?
Is dit enkel omdat de regeling daarmee budgettair neutraal is?
Asks for an overview of start-up tax reliefs and how the three-year choice is fixed and registered.
