v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the bill modernising the small-business VAT scheme (KOR) should be sent to parliament, but that the government must better justify switching to a new regime now, given an upcoming EU directive proposal that may require further changes soon; otherwise it should wait until the directive is adopted. The government's reply (nader rapport) states it has deliberately chosen to modernise now, explains why the conditions for derogation and the end of the standstill were weighed, and has supplemented the explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling asked why the switch to a new KOR regime is justified now, given a forthcoming EU directive proposal that may require another change shortly after; the government added general justification (long-standing wish to modernise, the existing scheme's growing complexity) and chose not to await the directive.

The Afdeling noted that the Belastingdienst's implementation assessment flags communication and system adaptation risks from two regime changes in quick succession; the reply does not specifically address this operational concern.

The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to clarify whether the transition meets the directive condition that it must not reduce tax; the government added this clarification in the general part of the memorandum.

The Afdeling asked for explanation of why the option to return to the degressive reduction after the end of the standstill was not considered; the government explained its assessment of that option and its likely irrelevance.

35042.s: The bill amends the Mediawet 2008 to clarify the approval procedure for new or significantly changed distribution channels of public broadcasters, tighten and modernise appointment procedures for supervisory boards and executive boards of public media bodies (NPO, RPO, NOS, NTR, Commissariaat, Stifo) and move the Ster to a board-of-supervision model with its own supervisory board and executive board. It also introduces an experimental channel exemption for regional broadcasters, extends the Commissariaat's exemption powers, and makes technical adjustments.
35042.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations and new minister powers by the stewardship responsibility of the minister for a pluriform public media system, the need for independent appointment procedures, and flexibility for regional broadcasters in a fast-changing media landscape.
q: The government therefore now proposes to provide clarity on this in the law.
De regering stelt daarom nu voor om hierover in de wet duidelijkheid te geven.
d: appointment procedure for Commissariaat members via binding advisory committee
rules on size/duration and conduct of experiments with new regional distribution channels
minister may allocate interest revenues to designated bodies
p: Artikel I, onder P (articles 2.99b-2.99e) and Q (article 2.100)

Replaces ministerial appointment of Ster executive board with a supervisory board model, moving appointment and dismissal power away from the minister toward an independent board, subject to minister's approval of profile sketches and a marginal review of nominations.
Minister may take necessary measures at the Ster if it seriously neglects its tasks, after consultation, with notice to the Tweede Kamer.
Artikel I, onder D (article 2.21, lid 4-7) and L (article 2.60m)

New channel approval includes a four-week public comment window and a discretionary minister's request for an ACM market analysis, with the uniform public preparation procedure applying and direct judicial appeal.

parties: Asks how market-effect analysis by the ACM works, whether the Minister can reverse decisions, and whether the Minister keeps sufficient instruments for pluralism and independence.
Does the Minister still have sufficient instruments to carry his systemic responsibility for a pluriform, well-functioning and independent public media system, these members ask.
Heeft de Minister nog voldoende instrumenten om zijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid voor een pluriform, goed functionerend en onafhankelijk publiek mediabestel te kunnen dragen, zo vragen deze leden.
Asks whether the Minister's remaining political involvement in appointments undermines Commissariaat independence and why the Minister keeps approval rights over profile sketches.
In short, to what extent and how does the government's proposal still involve dependence on political interference, and why did the government choose this, these members ask.

Kortom, in hoeverre en op welke wijze is er in het voorstel van de regering nog wel sprake van afhankelijkheid van politieke bemoeienis en waarom heeft de regering hiervoor gekozen, zo vragen deze leden.

Supports reduced ministerial role in appointments and independent oversight, but asks for transparency of appointment advisory committees, the weight of opinions, and public disclosure of motivations.
Asks how the proposals relate to a new public broadcasting vision, about board remuneration, independence of supervisory board members, and diversity.
Can the government elaborate on the requirements for the secondary positions of supervisory board members: what requirements apply?
Kan de regering nader ingaan op de eisen aan de nevenfuncties van de mensen in de raden van toezicht: welke eisen worden hieraan gesteld?
Questions the need for tighter procedures now, whether the change is required by EU rules, and the influence of large foreign media companies.
These members also ask whether it is correct that the actual procedure for approval now takes longer in practice than half a year.
Verder vragen deze leden of het klopt dat de werkelijke procedure dat er nu een goedkeuring wordt gegeven in praktijk niet een half jaar duurt, maar langer?
Doubts the necessity of the tighter new-services procedure given calls for a responsive public broadcaster, and suggests deferring it to the future media system debate.
Is it then wise to change the current procedure at this moment?
Is het wijzigen van de huidige procedure dan op dit moment verstandig?

v.summary: The Raad van State advised proceeding with the Mediawet 2008 amendment bill but requested removal of the proposed change to the appointment procedure for Commissariaat voor de Media board members, arguing no justification was given for departing from standard procedures and that the Minister's role would be marginal. The government's reply declined to remove the change, citing the Commissariaat's special position protecting media independence and the parliamentary motion-Paternotte/Van der Molen, while adding clarifications and an experimentation clause for the regional public media service.
concerns: The Afdeling objects that the proposed appointment procedure gives the Commissariaat itself a dominant role, leaving the Minister only marginal review, which departs from the usual role of the Minister in appointing supervisory board members.

The Afdeling finds the explanatory memorandum lacks justification for applying a different appointment procedure to Commissariaat members, given it does not provide media content and is purely a supervisor.

35060.s: The bill converts the private foundation Airport Coordination Netherlands (SACN) into a public-law independent administrative body (ACNL) that performs slot coordination and schedule facilitation tasks under the EU slot regulation. It transfers oversight from the existing supervisory board to the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat, who gains power to appoint, suspend and dismiss directors and to approve charges, while the Kaderwet articles allowing policy rules and annulment of decisions are switched off for ACNL.
35060.j: The memorandum justifies the shift of powers to the Minister as in line with government policy on independent administrative bodies, and the exclusion of Articles 21 and 22 as required by the independent task performance demanded by the EU slot regulation.
q: The shift of powers from the supervisory board to the Minister is in line with the cabinet's policy regarding independent administrative bodies.
De verschuiving van bevoegdheden van de RvT naar de Minister is in lijn met het beleid van het kabinet ten aanzien van zbo’s.
d: setting annual charges for slot and facilitated-movement fees
p: Artikel I, Titel 8A.7 (Artikel 8a.66 lid 4 and Artikel 8a.69 lid 3)
The Minister takes over appointment, suspension, dismissal of directors and approval of budgets and charges, replacing the supervisory board that previously oversaw the foundation.
Articles 21 and 22 of the Kaderwet, allowing the Minister to issue policy rules and annul decisions, are excluded, limiting ministerial control over ACNL's task performance..

parties: Asks how the functional and financial independence of SACN will be guaranteed after conversion into a public body.
The VVD members ask how it will be ensured that the functional and financial independence of SACN remains guaranteed.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe ervoor gezorgd wordt dat de functionele en financiële onafhankelijkheid van SACN gewaarborgd blijft.

Notes that abolishing the supervisory board shifts its powers to the Minister, making decisions political, and asks about advantages and disadvantages; also questions whether a maximum tariff could replace ministerial approval.
They also note that with the disappearance of the supervisory board, its powers shift to the Minister.
Tevens constateren zij dat met het verdwijnen van de raad van toezicht diens bevoegdheden verschuiven naar de Minister.
Welcomes that supervision of slot coordination moves to the Minister, giving stronger public accountability, while urging European modernisation of slot allocation rules.
The GroenLinks members are pleased that with this bill supervision of slot coordination, and therefore responsibility, moves to the Minister.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie zijn blij dat met dit wetsvoorstel het toezicht op de slotcoördinatie, en daarmee de verantwoordelijkheid, bij de Minister komt te liggen.

35123.s: The bill authorises the Minister of Finance to establish Invest-NL N.V., a national financing and development institution with a holding structure, and sets out its goals and tasks (development, investment, scheme execution, shareholder proxy). It also regulates financial management, competition and state aid limits, cost recovery, transitional transfers of existing assets, an evaluation duty, and related safeguards.
35123.j: The memorandum justifies flexibility in delegated rules by Invest-NL being a new organisation still in development and by the need to avoid fragmented parliamentary procedures.
q: Invest-NL is not an administrative body within the meaning of the General Administrative Law Act and is not vested with public authority.
Invest-NL is geen bestuursorgaan in de zin van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht en is niet met openbaar gezag bekleed
d: establishing Invest-NL and subsidiaries on behalf of the State
assigning additional tasks to Invest-NL and cost compensation
ministerial consent and conditions for activities beyond statutory tasks
rules on market-conform activities, including prohibitions
exemption from ban on financing Dutch public bodies
criteria and rules for development subsidies
binding instructions to Invest-NL on development tasks
obligation to use government facilities and know-how
tariffs and amount of cost compensation
p: Minister may consent to Invest-NL activities beyond its statutory tasks, with conditions set by the minister.
Minister may instruct termination of activities deemed market-distorting and act on Invest-NL's behalf and cost if deadline lapses.
Minister may issue binding instructions and impose orders on the development subsidiary, including appointing others to perform tasks.
Conservatory attachment against Invest-NL requires hearing the entity first, except where it concerns only goods.
Invest-NL is declared not an administrative body, so its investment decisions fall outside administrative law and are channelled to civil courts.

parties: Asks for an overview of all delegated powers (AMvB, ministerial regulations) and whether parliament is involved in advance and afterwards, and asks whether the state bears further financial risks.
The VVD asks for an overview of all delegated acts in the bill (AMvBs, ministerial regulations, etc.) and how parliament's involvement is arranged (prior and subsequent).

De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen of de regering een overzicht kan geven van alle gedelegeerde handelingen in het voorliggende wetsvoorstel (algemene maatregelen van bestuur (AMvB's), ministeriële regelingen, etc.) en hoe de betrokkenheid van de Kamer daarbij geregeld is (voor- en nahang).
Worries about political interference versus parliamentary control, and asks what formal control parliament will retain over key organisational and policy decisions.

On one hand they want to prevent Invest-NL becoming a political plaything with daily interference, but on the other want the States General to be able to exercise sufficient and good control over important organisational and policy issues.

Zij willen aan de ene kant voorkomen dat Invest-NL een politieke speelbal wordt met dagelijkse bemoeienis, maar wil aan de andere kant wel dat de Staten-Generaal voldoende en goede controle kan houden op belangrijke inrichtings- en beleidsvraagstukken.
Supports the aims but insists on respecting Invest-NL's business freedom and opposes politicisation via AMvB, and asks for quarterly parliamentary reporting on competition complaints.
These members consider it important that independent oversight is exercised over competition aspects.
Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat er onafhankelijk toezicht wordt gehouden op de mededingingsaspecten.
Criticises steering via an additional agreement withdrawn from parliamentary control, the complex holding structure, and the transfer of many instruments, questioning democratic oversight.
Asks how States General involvement is guaranteed if the agreement changes, why key policy domains are not set by AMvB with prior consultation, and how public interest is safeguarded.
If the agreement between the State and Invest-NL is changed, how is the involvement of the States General guaranteed?
Indien de overeenkomst tussen de Staat en Invest-NL gewijzigd gaat worden, hoe is dan de betrokkenheid van de Staten-Generaal gewaarborgd?
Wants investments focused on climate and transition goals and excluding fossil fuels, and asks whether the Chamber will have insight into and co-decide on the agreement.
Will the Chamber get insight into the agreement and co-decide on it?
Krijgt de Kamer inzicht in de overeenkomst en beslist de Kamer hierover mee?
Finds the broad statutory aims and the non-binding agreement too voluntary and asks why the government does not specify limits via the bill or delegated regulation.
The SGP members find this too non-binding.
De leden van de SGP-fractie vinden dit te vrijblijvend.

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised on the bill establishing Invest-NL, a state-owned financing and development institution with EUR 2.5 billion in capital, raising concerns about vague objectives, tasks, additionality, governance and legal protection. The government's reply (nader rapport) accepted some points (narrowing SME target group, Chinese walls, clarifying legal status and state aid enforcement) but rejected the advice to drop the supplementary agreement and the 'ondernemingsfinanciering' objective.
concerns: Vague objectives and tasks ('toegang tot ondernemingsfinanciering', 'bijdrage aan de Nederlandse economie') need sharper delimitation; government narrowed the task to SMEs and scale-ups but kept the financing objective.
Additionality criterion in article 8 is insufficiently precise; government added a transparent procedure and explanation in the memorie van toelichting but did not fix it in the statute.
The supplementary agreement between the state and Invest-NL risks policy steering that undermines the intended independence; government rejected dropping the agreement and explained its role.
Mixing subsidy-scheme implementation with investment tasks may compromise independence; government adopted Chinese walls and separate subsidiaries but kept the subsidy task within Invest-NL.
The normrendement (norm return) needs clearer determination to keep the capital injection outside EMU deficit; government added explanation to the memorie van toelichting.
Unclear whether Invest-NL is a bestuursorgaan under the Awb creates legal uncertainty; government added a statutory exclusion and clarified the legal relationships.
The mededingingsklacht procedure lacked clear criteria and a clear relation to additionality; article 10 was amended to refer to article 8(1).
Responsibility for state-aid compliance needs clear instruments for the minister; government clarified that Invest-NL is a publieke entiteit under the Wet Nerpe.

35204.s: The bill amends the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act to implement articles 15 and 16 of EU Directive 2014/40, creating a track-and-trace system with unique identifier markings, data storage contracts, and security features on tobacco packaging to combat illegal trade. It delegates many technical requirements to general administrative orders and ministerial regulations, and assigns enforcement to the customs authority and the NVWA.
35204.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the delegations by saying the technical and procedural details are too detailed for statute and must be adjusted in line with EU rules.
q: These requirements are of a procedural or technical nature, so they will be set by or pursuant to a general administrative order.
Deze eisen zijn van procedurele of technische aard, waardoor de eisen bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur gesteld zullen worden.
d: technical requirements for unique identifier markings
further rules on data storage and registration
rules implementing the EU tracking regulation
amending cross-references to EU legal acts
designation of officials from another ministry
p: The minister may request information and take measures against market actors under the referenced EU provisions, expanding executive enforcement discretion.
Artikel I, F (15, lid 2) and G (annex)
Customs supervisors and administrative fines extend enforcement powers and penalties to new obligations under the bill.

parties: Asks about implementation status, industry consultation, costs for producers, and the absence of an evaluation clause.
They have a few further questions on this.
Zij hebben hierbij nog enkele vragen.
Questions whether Atos is independent of the tobacco industry, whether the data provider is free of industry ties, and whether the fines are an effective enforcement tool.
Can the government guarantee that Atos has no ties with the tobacco industry?
Kan de regering garanderen dat Atos geen banden heeft met de tabaksindustrie?
Asks how many and which requirements will be set for the security feature by AMvB and whether authentication elements meet ISO standards.
Does the government intend to specify each of the five types of authentication elements that the security feature must minimally consist of?
Is de regering van plan om de vijf soorten authenticatie-elementen waaruit het veiligheidskenmerk minimaal moet bestaan stuk voor stuk te specificeren?
Asks how effective the measures will be in reducing illicit trade and whether the planned excise increase will increase illicit trade.
These members ask to what extent the proposed measures will reduce illegal trade.
Genoemde leden vragen in hoeverre de voorgenomen maatregelen de illegale handel zullen terugdringen.
Supports the track-and-trace obligation but questions the low fines, the discretion left to member states, and the rules on compensation for investigations.
These members believe these sanctions amount to little when the possible proceeds of illegal trade in tobacco products are taken into account.
Genoemde leden menen dat deze sancties niet veel voor stellen als er rekening wordt gehouden met de mogelijke opbrengsten van illegale handel in tabaksproducten.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill implementing Articles 15 and 16 of EU Directive 2014/40 (unique identifiers and security features on tobacco products), raising points on implementation method, mandate to the ID issuer, and designating customs as supervisor, with remarks to adjust the explanatory memorandum. The Staatssecretaris's nader rapport accepted most points, amending the Adw annex and economic offences act, while declining to delete certain phrases referring to the implementing regulation.
concerns: The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to explain how the implementing regulation's technical requirements, which apply directly, relate to national rules, and the government supplemented the memorandum.

The Afdeling asked the explanatory memorandum to explain how the minister keeps administrative-law responsibility for decisions of the commercial ID issuer acting under mandate and how independence is secured; the explanatory memorandum was supplemented.
The Afdeling asked that the customs supervisory designation be aligned with the Algemene douanewet annex; the government amended the Adw annex to add the Tabaks- en rookwarenwet.

The Afdeling proposed deleting several phrases and adding a transposition table entry; the government did not delete the phrases but added the sanctions provision to the economic offences act and clarified the transposition.

35210-V.s: This bill amends the 2019 departmental budget of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs through a first supplementary budget, adjusting spending and revenue figures across policy and non-policy articles. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect on 1 June 2019 with retroactive effect where the Staatsblad appears later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2019;
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V), voor het jaar 2019;

35213.s: The bill harmonises the Wajong disability benefit regimes for young disabled people, tightening work-activation duties (acceptance of suitable work, re-integration plans) and replacing income and benefit formulas with a single scheme. It also removes several legal provisions, adds a guarantee amount for current beneficiaries, and lets the implementing body (UWV, renamed Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen) and ministerial regulations set further details.
35213.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated detail (income definition, guarantee calculation, exemptions) by the need for harmonised and workable implementation by UWV.
q: The wish is to also be able to record the obligation to accept a suitable job offer in the re-integration vision and re-integration plan.
Het is de wens om de verplichting een passend werkaanbod te accepteren ook vast te mogen leggen in de re-integratievisie en het re-integratieplan.
d: groups of fully and permanently disabled exempt from income review
p: Re-integration plans may impose an obligation on young disabled people to accept concrete suitable work offers, with benefit consequences for refusal.
Removes the participation-plan conditions and the statutory disability classes, shifting determinations of benefit entitlement to administrative discretion.
Introduces mandatory review of continued full disability when earnings exceed 20% of the standard income, with exemptions set by ministerial regulation.
Expands grounds for revision or withdrawal of decisions and makes the implementing body's relief from revision discretionary.
Removes the five-year time limit for reinstating benefit claims, reducing a fixed protection for beneficiaries.

parties: Asks how the harmonised income rules work for those in the Wajong 2015, the guarantee amount and whether a simple calculation tool can be provided to beneficiaries.
How can those affected verify whether they receive the correct amount?
Hoe valt het voor betrokkenen na te rekenen of zij het juiste bedrag ontvangen hebben?
Worries that people with medical working-hour limits lose income and are pushed under the bijstand regime, and that complex rules could cause repayment claims for people with fluctuating incomes.
It must be prevented that people who cannot work full-time due to their disability remain below the minimum wage their whole lives and thus under the bijstand regime with its duties and sanctions.

Voorkomen moet worden dat mensen die als gevolg van hun beperking niet fulltime kunnen werken, hun hele leven onder het WML blijven vallen en daarmee onder het bijstandsregime met de bijbehorende plichten en sancties.
Supports the guarantee scheme and clarity but asks how it works with fluctuating incomes and why people with medical working-hour limits do not get a free allowance comparable to the Participatiewet.
These members ask the government to explain why, analogous to the Participatiewet, no income disregard was chosen for this group in the Wajong for the new situation.

Deze leden vragen de regering uiteen te zetten waarom er niet voor gekozen is, analoog aan de Participatiewet, een inkomensvrijlating voor deze doelgroep in de Wajong voor de nieuwe situatie in te stellen.
Doubts the bill makes the Wajong simpler, cites UWV and organisations warning of persisting complexity, and asks why UWV's recommendations were not adopted.
Why does the government so stubbornly hold on to the principle that (more) work must pay, while all involved organisations indicate that comprehensibility should currently be the highest goal?

Waarom houdt de regering zo halsstarrig vast aan het principe dat (meer) werken moet lonen, terwijl alle betrokken organisaties aangeven dat begrijpelijkheid op dit moment het hoogste doel zou moeten zijn om meer Wajongers te laten participeren?

Supports simplification but is seriously worried about people losing income after job loss, the inequality with the Participatiewet noted by the Raad van State, and people with medical working-hour limits.
Although the SP members support the aim of the law (simplification and making work pay), they are seriously worried about groups who lose income.
Hoewel de leden van de SP-fractie het doel van de wet steunen (vereenvoudiging en werken lonend maken), maken zij zich ernstig zorgen over groepen die er op achteruit gaan.
Worries that the bill does not guarantee adequate livelihood security, that people with reduced hours fall below the minimum wage, and that implementation errors could cause repayment and debt.
The PvdA members ask whether it is fair that people who through no fault of their own cannot work more hours earn below the minimum wage.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen of het rechtvaardig is dat mensen die buiten hun schuld om niet meer uren kunnen werken onder het minimumloon verdienen.

Welcomes simplification and retention of benefits during study but asks for worked examples, questions the treatment of people with medical hour limits and the guarantee's duration, and the DGA threshold.
Is it true that someone who cannot work full-time due to an hours limitation will never receive 100 percent of the minimum wage under the new rules, even if they work to their capacity?
Is het waar dat iemand die vanwege een urenbeperking niet fulltime kan werken, in de nieuwe regels nooit 100 procent van het WML zal krijgen, ook niet als hij naar vermogen werkt?
Supports making work pay and reducing unfair differences but asks about uncertainties of the guarantee scheme, the short two-month period, and how further harmonisation will be studied.
These members ask how the government intends to examine, alongside this bill, the extent to which further harmonisation is possible and necessary in the coming period.
Deze leden vragen op welke wijze de regering naast het traject van dit wetsvoorstel de komende tijd wil onderzoeken in hoeverre verdergaande harmonisatie mogelijk en nodig is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised, on a bill amending the Wajong and harmonising its income and benefit-regime rules, that the explanatory memorandum should be broadened to address similar inconsistencies outside the Wajong, such as differences with the Participatiewet and WIA/WAO, and the bill adjusted if needed. The Staatssecretaris's reply accepts the need for broader consideration, explains the differences as respect for existing rights and the distinct character of the Wajong and Participatiewet, and notes that harmonisation is not an end in itself.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a broader justification of harmonisation, covering inconsistencies with the Participatiewet and other social security laws not addressed in the bill, and the government accepted the need for a broader view but did not extend the reach of the bill.

The Afdeling noted that the reasoning for the change in the reinstatement rules is limited and not clearly extended to WIA and WAO, while the government explained that these regimes serve different aims.
The Afdeling made editorial remarks, which the government has followed in the amended bill and explanatory memorandum.

35300-V.s: The bill sets the 2020 departmental budget (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, fixing expenditure of about EUR 10.35 billion and receipts of about EUR 787 million in thousands of euros. It takes effect on 1 January 2020 and, if published later, applies retroactively from that date.
q: Article 1 The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (V) for the year 2020 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2020 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State made no remarks on the 2020 budget bills (begrotingsstaten) and advised submitting them to the Tweede Kamer, as blanco advice. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes to the reply.

35303.s: The bill amends several Dutch tax and benefit laws for the 2020 fiscal policy, covering shipping tonnage regime, WOZ property valuation data sharing, electronic versus paper correspondence choices, publication of fines against facilitators of tax evasion, vehicle tax (WLTP), and the Caribbean Netherlands tax rules. Most provisions are substantive tax changes, with several new ministerial-regulation delegations on digital communication, notification deadlines and standard choices.
35303.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by the need to adapt to changing technical possibilities and digitalisation pace, and to allow adequate exceptions for particular groups.
q: The ministerial regulation determines the scope of the choice arrangement and, as now under the Wet EBV, provides an exhaustive regime for message traffic.
De ministeriële regeling bepaalt de reikwijdte van de keuzeregeling en voorziet, evenals nu het geval is onder de Wet EBV, in een uitputtende regeling voor het berichtenverkeer.
d: which messages are sent only electronically or only on paper
exceptions to taxpayer choice of electronic or paper correspondence
exceptions to electronic or paper correspondence for collection
default electronic or paper setting for non-responding persons
Artikel XXVII Wet uitwerking Autobrief II, artikel 23 (fijnstoftoeslag)
particulate surcharge conditions for diesel cars
Artikel X, onderdeel B (artikel 40a Wet WOZ)
third parties allowed to obtain WOZ valuation data
rules for applying successiewet provisions to deadlines
Artikel II, onderdeel E (artikel 42a Awir) and Artikel XI (artikel 67r AWR)
rules on publication of fines against facilitating professionals
p: Artikel II, onderdeel E (artikel 42a Awir); Artikel XI, onderdeel N (artikel 67r AWR)
Tax administration may publicly name professionals fined as accomplices, subject to a proportionality test, a right to comment and normal objection and appeal.
The tax administration may set a default electronic or paper channel for taxpayers who make no choice and may request citizen service numbers for this purpose.

parties: Asks how legal certainty is secured when only certain penalties are published, and whether citizens can always communicate with the government.
The VVD members ask how legal certainty is secured if only certain fines are made public.
De leden van de VVD-fractie vragen hoe de rechtszekerheid geborgd wordt, als slechts bepaalde boetes openbaar gemaakt worden.
Questions whether the rule on reopening decisions with retroactive effect infringes legal certainty and whether the default electronic mail choice is adequately safeguarded.
But the measure allowing a decision to be revised in case of a new fact, bad faith or an error reasonably recognisable to the taxpayer seems to them rather a restriction of legal certainty.

Maar de maatregel om een beschikking te kunnen herzien in geval van een nieuw feit, kwade trouw of een voor de belastingplichtige redelijkerwijs kenbare fout lijkt hen eerder een inperking van de rechtszekerheid.
Asks whether publication of penalties is effective and why publications cannot be guaranteed to be removed after five years.
These members ask why the government cannot guarantee that reporting on the publication of penalties is not removed after five years.
Deze leden vragen waarom de regering niet kan garanderen dat berichtgeving rondom openbaarmaking van vergrijpboeten niet na vijf jaar wordt verwijderd.
Asks why the advisor but not the taxpayer is published, whether defendants can avoid publication via closed-door hearings, and requests data on past penalties.
The GroenLinks members ask whether it is correct that the accessory professional can always request that the case be heard behind closed doors and the ruling not be published.
De leden van de fractie van GroenLinks vragen of het klopt dat de medeplegende beroepsbeoefenaar altijd kan vragen om de zaak achter gesloten deuren te behandelen en de uitspraak niet te publiceren.

Questions the proportionality of further appeal options against publication and worries that the tax inspector is placed in a vulnerable position by both imposing the penalty and deciding on publication.
They are also concerned about placing the assessment of individual cases with the tax inspector and ask whether the government agrees that this puts the inspector in a vulnerable position.

Zij maken zich tevens zorgen over het beleggen van beoordeling van individuele gevallen bij de inspecteur der belastingen en vragen de regering of zij de mening deelt dat de inspecteur hiermee in een kwetsbare positie wordt gebracht.
Asks why the criterion of gross negligence was not chosen for publication of penalties.
The PvdA members ask why it was not chosen to align with gross negligence as the criterion.
De leden van de PvdA-fractie vragen waarom er niet voor is gekozen aan te sluiten bij grove schuld als criterium.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on the Overige Fiscale Maatregelen 2020 bill, mainly on publishing final fine decisions against tax professionals who facilitate tax and benefit fraud, raising concerns about unclear purpose, effectiveness, the scope of the measure, evaluation, alternatives like disciplinary law, and GDPR and legal-design issues. The government's reply accepts most points, clarifies the sole purpose as informing the public, narrows publication to co-perpetrators, adds an evaluation note, deletes the GDPR-related passages, and restructures the AWR provisions.
concerns: The Afdeling said the purpose (transparency versus deterrence) was unclear and that the long procedure could undermine effectiveness; the government clarified the sole purpose as informing the public and narrowed the scope to co-perpetrators.

The Afdeling questioned whether publication of fines against advisers was proportionate given the limited use of such fines so far; the government narrowed the measure to co-perpetrator fines but kept the rule-of-law priority of the lengthy procedure.
The Afdeling asked that the evaluation section explicitly address publication of fines; the government added this.
The Afdeling said disciplinary law already offers an alternative and advised a motivated exception for advisers under professional codes; the government rejected a categorical exception.
The Afdeling flagged GDPR limits on the five-year publication period and personal data; the government deleted the relevant passages.

The Afdeling advised restructuring the AWR provisions into a separate section with the proportionality test as discretion and consent moved to the Besluit Bestuurlijke Boeten; the government adopted this.

35321.s: The bill extends the smoking ban in the Tobacco and Smoking Products Act to cover the consumption of tobacco products other than by smoking, and the vapour of electronic cigarettes with or without nicotine. The ban is enforced by the venue operator and supervised by the NVWA, which can impose administrative fines.
35321.j: The memorandum justifies the extended ban by the goal of a smoke-free generation and by the need for legal clarity, and it weighs enforceability and proportionality against privacy under Article 8 ECHR.
q: Legally codifying the ban on consuming tobacco products and e-cigarettes creates clarity for both users and non-users about what is and is not permitted.
Het wettelijk vastleggen van het verbod op de consumptie van tabaksproducten en de e-sigaret schept zowel voor gebruikers als niet-gebruikers duidelijkheid over wat wel en niet is toegestaan.

parties: Asks whether the gateway argument for e-cigarettes rests on causation rather than correlation and wants the forthcoming research results before relying on it.
Said members are of the view that correlation should not be confused with causality here.
Genoemde leden zijn van mening dat correlatie hier niet verward moet worden met causaliteit.
Asks whether the government will await pending research on e-cigarette emissions before enacting the amendment and questions the effectiveness of some measures.
They ask whether the government is willing to await this research before implementing this legislative amendment.
Zij vragen of de regering bereid is om dit onderzoek af te wachten voor dat zij deze wetswijziging doorvoert.
Asks how the consultation arguments were weighed under WHO FCTC Article 5.3 and whether tobacco industry input was submitted anonymously.
Can it be ruled out that arguments from the tobacco lobby were submitted anonymously via the internet consultation?
Valt uit te sluiten dat via de internetconsultatie argumenten van de tabakslobby op anonieme wijze zijn ingebracht?
Welcomes the government's adherence to the agreements of the national prevention accord.
These members appreciate that the government is honouring the agreements made within the National Prevention Accord for a smoke-free generation.
Deze leden waarderen het dat de regering de afspraken die in het kader van het Nationaal Preventieakkoord ten behoeve van de rookvrije generatie zijn gemaakt, zo gestand doet.

Supports the extension but asks whether its scope is broad enough to cover future products, how owners will be informed, and why herbal smoking products are excluded and not distinguished from tobacco waterpipes.
They ask the government whether the proposed extension has sufficient scope to ensure all new products fall under it.
Zij vragen de regering of de voorgestelde uitbreiding voldoende reikwijdte heeft om te zorgen dat alle nieuwe producten hieronder zullen vallen.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a draft bill extending the smoking ban in public and government buildings to chewing/snuff tobacco and e-cigarettes with or without nicotine, raising concerns about the evidence base for the 'stepping-stone' theory and the unjustified exclusion of herbal smoking preparations. The minister's reply states the explanatory memorandum was supplemented with additional sources and a fuller justification for excluding herbal smoking products.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum should reflect the current state of scientific research on the e-cigarette stepping-stone theory and cite more sources; the government added references and footnotes.

The exclusion of herbal smoking preparations from the smoking ban needs substantive justification beyond reference to the preventive agreement; the government added an explanation in chapter 9 on the differing contribution to undermining the non-smoking norm.
The Afdeling's editorial remarks in the attached annex were adopted.

35402.s: The bill amends the Dutch Code of Criminal Procedure and the Act on mutual recognition and enforcement of financial penalties and confiscation decisions to implement EU Regulation 2018/1805 on freezing and confiscation orders, covering incoming and outgoing orders and their enforcement. It sets out refusal grounds, prioritisation rules and appeal routes to the Noord-Nederland court, and allows appeals against recognition decisions to proceed without suspensive effect.
35402.j: The memorandum justifies the new powers as necessary for direct application of the EU regulation and effective enforcement of criminal decisions, and states that the Minister should be competent for outgoing orders for effective enforcement.
q: The substantive grounds of the confiscation order cannot be challenged, because the decision to confiscate is reserved to the issuing authority.
De materiële gronden van het confiscatiebevel kunnen niet worden aangevochten, omdat de beslissing tot confiscatie is voorbehouden aan de uitvaardigende autoriteit.
p: Public prosecutors and the Minister are given discretion to refuse recognition or enforcement of freezing and confiscation orders on the listed grounds, which were made optional rather than mandatory.
Affected persons may appeal recognition and enforcement decisions to the court, though review is limited to reasonableness and the appeal does not suspend enforcement.
Aggrieved parties may complain in writing against freezing order recognition, but the court will not examine the basis of the order and the complaint has no suspensive effect.

parties: Supports confiscation and freezing of criminal assets but asks about applicability to Denmark, Ireland and the UK, and about consultation of the judiciary after impact evaluations.
Can the government indicate whether this still has consequences for Dutch implementation practice?
Kan de regering aangeven of dit nog gevolgen heeft voor de Nederlandse uitvoeringspraktijk?
Questions whether the public prosecutor is sufficiently independent given ministerial steering, whether a judicial authority is required, and whether refusal grounds should be mandatory.
Following a ruling of the Court of Justice of the European Union, the investigating judge is designated in this law as the independent authority and not the public prosecutor.
Vanwege een uitspraak van het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie is de rechter-commissaris in deze wet aangemerkt als de onafhankelijke autoriteit en niet de officier van justitie
Supports European cooperation against organised crime but asks whether the CJEU rulings affect the central role of the public prosecutor and whether workload from incoming orders was considered.
These members are curious whether the rulings of the European Court of Justice in the two aforementioned cases can still play a role in this bill.
Deze leden zijn benieuwd of de uitspraken van het Europese Hof van Justitie in de twee bovengenoemde zaken nog een rol kan spelen in onderhavig wetsvoorstel.

Doubts that mutual trust among member states is justified given rule-of-law concerns, asks how wrongful orders are prevented, and asks whether legal protection and complaint procedures are guaranteed.

Is the government of the opinion that at this time, when the rule of law has come under pressure in various member states, it is responsible to intensify and further expand cooperation based on blind trust?

Is de regering van mening dat op dit moment, waarin in verschillende lidstaten de rechtsstaat onder druk is komen te staan, het verantwoord is om samenwerking op basis van blindelings vertrouwen te intensiveren en verder uit te breiden?

v.summary: The Council of State's advisory division advised that the bill's mandatory refusal grounds for recognising and executing confiscation orders under Regulation 2018/1805 may conflict with EU case law (Poplawski I), which requires discretion, and asked the explanatory memorandum to justify or adapt them. The government's reply accepted the advice, converting the mandatory grounds into optional ones in Article 36 WWETGC, and made some drafting corrections.
concerns: Mandatory refusal grounds in the bill may be incompatible with the Confiscation Regulation and CJEU case law, since authorities must retain discretion; the explanatory memorandum should address this and the bill be adapted.
Redactional remarks, including adding a transposition table and deleting the words 'andere lidstaat' from article headings, were incorporated.

35501.s: The bill amends the Wet terugkeer en vreemdelingenbewaring to allow the prison director to temporarily depart from minimum daily rights of detained migrants (up to four weeks, but always at least one hour outdoors daily) during emergency lockdowns, with written notice and a complaint route. It also lets the Minister impose residence-area and reporting restrictions and require security on migrants without lawful residence, and extends detention grounds for EU nationals without lawful residence.
35501.j: The memorandum justifies the lockdown power by the need to restore order and safety during serious incidents such as group aggression against staff, limited to exceptional cases.
q: It is emphasised that this is a statutory provision for exceptional situations, intended only for cases where deviation is strictly necessary.
Benadrukt wordt dat het gaat om een wettelijke voorziening voor uitzonderingssituaties, die slechts bedoeld is voor gevallen waarin afwijking strikt noodzakelijk is.
d: conditions, duration and circumstances of area restrictions and reporting duties
conditions for requiring security from migrants
p: The prison director may depart for up to four weeks from statutory rights to movement and daily activity when strictly necessary for order and safety, retaining a minimum one hour outdoors per day.
The Minister may impose area restrictions and reporting obligations on migrants without lawful residence, with these ceasing when the migrant states willingness to leave.
Detainees must be notified in writing with reasons of temporary deviations and of complaint and appeal routes, and the supervisory commission must be informed.
EU nationals without lawful residence may be detained for expulsion on grounds of flight risk, obstruction or threat, for up to three months.

parties: Supports firm action but asks how measures are limited to a small group and how proportionality is monitored during use.
They are curious how the use of measures is kept to as limited a group as possible and how proportionality of the deployment is regularly checked during use.

Wel zijn deze leden benieuwd op welke manier wordt getracht de inzet van maatregelen tot een zo beperkt mogelijke groep te beperken en hoe er tijdens de inzet van de maatregelen met regelmaat wordt gekeken naar proportionaliteit van de inzet.
Questions why detention is not expanded more and why offenders are housed with free care rather than returned.

Why does the government choose to reward notorious nuisance asylum seekers in the HTL set up by the government with free accommodation and entertainment, such as gaming and painting, instead of putting them on a plane to their country of origin?

Waarom kiest de regering ervoor om notoire overlastgevende asielzoekers te belonen in de door de regering opgerichte HTL met gratis opvang en vertier, zoals gamen en schilderen, in plaats van ze op het vliegtuig naar het land van herkomst te zetten?
Welcomes the bill and asks for clarification on detention grounds and implementation issues.
They endorse the importance of being able to act against nuisance-causing foreigners and therefore welcome this amendment by the government.
Zij onderschrijven het belang om te kunnen optreden tegen overlastgevende vreemdelingen en juichen deze novelle van de regering daarom toe.
Questions the justification for the lock-down power and its duration, which the Council of State considered should last only days, and asks how it fits constitutional and treaty rules.
These members ask the government to explain why it does not choose a shorter period, or a system in which, in extreme necessity, a lock-down of a few days can be extended.
Deze leden vragen de regering toe te lichten waarom zij niet kiest voor een kortere periode, of een systeem waarin – in uiterste nood – een lock down van enkele dagen kan worden verlengd.
Doubts the necessity of collective lock-downs, flags collective punishment and detention conditions, and questions weak oversight by the supervisory committee and inspectorate.
The GroenLinks members point out that the lock-down measure in the proposed amendment effectively regulates a form of collective punishment.
De leden van de GroenLinks-fractie wijzen erop dat met de lock down maatregel in de voorgestelde novelle door de regering feitelijk een vorm van collectief straffen wordt gereguleerd.
Asks for statutory criteria for directors to impose and lift lock-downs so their legality can be reviewed, and questions the duration and rights restrictions for innocent detainees.
These members consider it important that these guidelines be laid down in the law or in a general administrative order. Then it is possible to review the lawfulness of the lock-down.
Deze leden vinden het belangrijk dat deze richtlijnen worden vastgelegd in de wet of in een algemene maatregel van bestuur. Dan is het mogelijk te toetsen op de rechtmatigheid van de lock down.
Accepts a lock-down may be needed in extreme cases but asks for differentiation, individual appeal to the court and a check by a third party on the director's decision.
Furthermore, the PvdA members understand that the decision for a lock-down is taken by the director of the facility concerned. Is any review by a third person or body possible at that moment?

Verder begrijpen de leden van de PvdA-fractie dat het besluit tot een lockdown door de directeur van de desbetreffende inrichting wordt genomen. Is daar op dat moment enige toets door een derde persoon of instantie voor mogelijk?
Considers the four-week maximum too long for sudden, short-lived incidents and proposes a one-week period extendable to four.

It therefore seems better to these members that this measure can be imposed for a maximum period of one week and, at the end of that period, if necessary, extended by a week up to a maximum of four weeks.

Het lijkt de aan het woord zijnde leden daarom beter dat deze maatregel voor een periode van maximaal een week opgelegd kan worden en aan het einde van die periode indien nodig met een week verlengd tot een maximum van vier weken.
Asks about current daily programmes, complaint procedure misuse, detention capacity and criminal records of detainees, without raising checks on the executive.
Members of the PVV faction note that the bill will expand the possibilities of the day programmes.
De leden van de PVV-fractie merken op dat met het wetsvoorstel de mogelijkheden van de dagprogramma's uit zullen breiden.
Argues the exceptional-circumstances derogation needs clear criteria and safeguards to avoid undue restriction of fundamental rights, and questions the reference to penitentiary law.
These members note that such a restriction of fundamental rights must be accompanied by clear criteria under which the measure can be imposed and lifted again.
Deze leden constateren dat een dergelijke inperking van grondrechten gepaard moet gaan met duidelijke criteria waaronder de maatregel kan worden ingesteld en ook weer moet worden opgeheven.
Supports the bill's extra powers against nuisance migrants and asks whether staff shortages could count as exceptional circumstances.
These members consider it essential that the migration chain has sufficient powers to act against nuisance-causing migrants.
Deze leden vinden het essentieel dat de vreemdelingenketen over voldoende bevoegdheden beschikt om op te kunnen treden tegen overlastgevende vreemdelingen.
Asks for quantified effects, triggering criteria, duration limits, parliamentary consent for extensions, and a stop mechanism for data use and detention extensions.
Is the government willing to anchor a sunset clause in law (for example a total maximum duration of 6 months) and allow extension only after prior parliamentary approval?
Is de regering bereid een horizonbepaling wettelijk te verankeren (bijvoorbeeld een totale maximumduur van 6 maanden) en verlenging uitsluitend na voorafgaande Kamerinstemming toe te staan?
Demands human rights impact analysis, objective criteria for lockdowns, ex officio judicial review, minimum outdoor time, access to legal aid and interpreters, and independent monitoring.
They note that a lockdown can affect the assessment of the lawfulness of detention within the meaning of Article 5 ECHR.
Zij merken daarbij op dat een lockdown invloed kan hebben op de beoordeling van de rechtmatigheid van bewaring in de zin van artikel 5 EVRM.
Has no questions on the amendment note.
These members have no questions about this.
Deze leden hebben hier geen vragen over.
Has no further questions on the bill.
They have no further questions about it.
Zij hebben hierover geen verdere vragen.

Criticises the four-week lockdown as a disproportionate collective punishment affecting innocents, notes unresolved staffing and privacy concerns, and questions the lack of justification for the powers.
These members are critical of this because a four-week lockdown is exceptionally long and is a collective punishment that indiscriminately also affects innocent people.
Voornoemde leden zijn hier kritisch op omdat 4 weken lockdown buitengewoon lang is en het een collectieve straf betreft die ongericht ook onschuldigen raakt.
Asks how the open term 'exceptional circumstances' squares with the infringement of rights and what limits apply, and how DJI will cope with limited capacity.
The SGP members ask the government to address the tension between the open-ended term 'exceptional circumstances' in the bill and the infringement of the rights of the foreigners concerned.

De leden van de SGP-fractie vragen de regering in te gaan op het spanningsveld tussen het open karakter van de term «uitzonderlijke omstandigheden» in het voorstel en de inbreuk op rechten van de desbetreffende vreemdelingen.
Asks for concrete criteria for exceptional circumstances to protect legal certainty, questions the 23-hour lockdown proportionality, and asks about the outdoor-time restriction.
These members are of the opinion that this is still very vague and that legal certainty is thereby endangered.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat dit nog steeds heel vaag is en dat de rechtszekerheid daarmee in gevaar komt.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised on a bill amending the Wet terugkeer en vreemdelingenbewaring to allow a lockdown of up to 23 hours a day for detainees, and found the proposed six-week maximum too long, advising a shorter duration. The government's nader rapport accepts the concern, reduces the maximum to four weeks, clarifies the scope of the lockdown power and the EU-citizen detention provision, and agrees to seek consultation advice from relevant bodies.
concerns: The six-week maximum duration of a general lockdown is too long given its far-reaching character and the Wtvb principle of minimal restrictions; a duration of a few days is considered more appropriate.
Confining detainees up to 23 hours a day is a serious restriction, so the power must be limited as far as possible and remain subject to safeguards.
The scope of the EU-citizen detention provision (art. 59d Vw 2000) should use the correct category and the purpose clause should be adjusted, which was done.
Consultation advice from relevant expert bodies should have been sought; the government agreed to request advice from the Adviescommissie, RSJ, Nationale ombudsman and others.
Article 5(1) should clarify that the lockdown power only derogates from article 36 insofar as it concerns freedom of movement and daily activities.

35600.s: The bill anchors a binding nitrogen-deposition environmental value for Natura 2000 habitats in the Nature Conservation Act and Environment Act, with a Minister-adopted reduction programme and monitoring duties. It also allows an exemption from the Natura 2000 permit requirement for temporary construction-sector emissions, to be specified by general administrative order.
35600.j: The memorandum justifies the delegations by pointing to the need for a flexible, detailed programme and to the Raad van State's PAS ruling, and says amvb drafts will be pre-tabled in parliament.
q: The elaboration of the statutory rules takes place in a general administrative order (amvb), the draft of which will be pre-tabled in parliament.
De uitwerking van de wettelijke regels vindt plaats in een algemene maatregel van bestuur (hierna ook: amvb), waarvan het ontwerp bij het parlement zal worden voorgehangen.
d: Minister adopts nitrogen reduction and nature restoration programme
public preparation procedure for programme and amendments
designated authority may amend, replace or add measures to programme
designation of bodies collecting monitoring data
content of programme, data collection, assessment and reporting rules
designation of construction activities exempt from Natura 2000 permit requirement and further conditions
Minister adopts nitrogen programme under Environment Act
p: The designated authority may unilaterally amend or drop programme measures if it shows they remain broadly consistent with the programme, without a fixed procedure for parliament or affected parties.
Construction-sector activities may be exempted from the Natura 2000 permit requirement by general administrative order, removing case-by-case permit review for temporary emissions."
The minister must amend the programme when assessments show the target will be missed and update it at least every six years.

parties: Asks how permitting timelines, the development reserve and the realism of a favourable conservation status are substantiated.
Can the government set out on a sound basis how and at what pace permitting room will arise in the coming years as a result of the structural approach?
Kan de regering gefundeerd uiteenzetten hoe en in welk tempo de komende jaren als gevolg van de structurele aanpak de ruimte voor vergunningverlening ontstaat?
Wants a better balance between ecology and economy and asks about socio-economic weighing under the Habitats Directive.
Both in the literature and in practice it appears that this is strongly one-sidedly focused on protecting nature.
Zowel in de literatuur als in de praktijk blijkt dat een en ander sterk eenzijdig gericht is op het beschermen van de natuur.
Supports a binding result obligation but questions the legal guarantees, the 2030 target and the consequences if it is missed.
Is the government of the view that the current proposal provides sufficient legal safeguarding for nature?
Is de regering van mening dat met het huidige voorstel voldoende juridische borging is voor de natuur?
Says too little is happening and asks why the target stops at 2030 and why the Advisory Board's 2040 goal and larger NNN are not adopted.
Why has a target been set only for 2030 and not for 2040?
Waarom is er alleen een doel voor 2030 gesteld en niet voor 2040?
Doubts the bill solves the problems, the discretion to delay conservation improvements is legally questionable, and PAS-notifiers face retroactive illegality.
They dispute however that this freedom also applies when it comes to preventing deterioration of the conservation objectives.
Deze leden betwisten echter dat deze vrijheid ook geldt waar het gaat om het tegengaan van de verslechtering van de instandhoudingsdoelstellingen.
Says the ambition level is insufficient, asks for accountability on provincial coordination and whether PAS-notifications are legally secure.
Supports tackling nitrogen but wants perspective for entrepreneurs and a quick solution for PAS-notifiers.
An important point of attention for these members is the so-called PAS-notifiers.
Een belangrijk aandachtspunt voor deze leden hierbij zijn de zogenoemde PAS-melders.
Argues the bill is legally untenable, gives insufficient improvement and will likely fail before the courts; the 26% reduction is too weak.
These members infer from the case law, expert advice and the Council of State's advice that this bill is legally untenable.
Deze leden maken uit de jurisprudentie, de adviezen van experts en het advies van de Raad van State op dat dit wetsvoorstel juridisch onhoudbaar is.
Asks about legalisation of PAS-notifiers, management measures in saldering, and monitoring of habitat development.
Rejects the bill, arguing the nitrogen policy focuses too narrowly on agriculture and has little effect on nature.
How is it prevented that this creates tunnel vision?
Hoe wordt voorkomen dat hierdoor een tunnelvisie ontstaat?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the nitrogen bill be amended: enshrine the nitrogen deposition environmental standard in the law itself, explain the measures, timeline and implementation instruments, and replace the construction-sector exemption with one justified by a credible structural package. The minister's reply reports that the advice was followed on all points, adding the standard to the Wet natuurbescherming and Omgevingswet, supplementing the explanatory memorandum, adding implementation instruments, and deleting the construction-sector standard.
concerns: The bill lacks a substantiated environmental standard and reasoning on whether the reduction target is sufficient to achieve favourable conservation status in Natura 2000 areas; the reply added this justification.

The bill does not provide insight into the source measures, choices and timeline needed to meet the environmental standard; the reply added instruments and a detailed discussion in the explanatory memorandum.

The partial exemption from the Natura 2000 permit requirement for construction emissions is not adequately justified; the reply removed the construction-sector standard and justified the exemption on the structural package.

The essential environmental standard should be laid down in the law in the formal sense rather than by general administrative order, so parliament co-determines its nature and scope; the reply enshrined it in the Wet natuurbescherming and Omgevingswet.

35925-I.s: This bill sets the 2022 budget of the Crown (Begroting I, the King's budget), totalling 48,203 thousand euro, covering constitutional allowances to royal family members, functional expenditure of the King, and cross-charged costs. It is a budget-approval law that adopts the budget statement in thousands of euros and sets entry into force on 1 January 2022.
q: The budget statement for the year 2022 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2022 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the 2022 state budget bill (Wet houdende vaststelling van de begrotingsstaten), finding no remarks and recommending submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments, which are set out in annexes.

36014.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, adding extra funds for examinations and a COVID-19 support package for the cultural and creative sector. It takes effect on 25 January 2022, or the day after publication if published later, retroactive to that date.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (VIII) for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (VIII) voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36050.s: The bill amends the Electricity and Drinking Water BES Act and the Housing, Spatial Planning and Environment BES Act to improve drinking water accessibility and sustainability in Caribbean Netherlands, clarify the boundary with the Warenwet BES, and extend the island authorities' wastewater duty from household sewage collection to full wastewater management funded by a new wastewater levy. It also gives the minister powers to take measures in exceptional circumstances to safeguard drinking water supply, while stating that these do not affect ACM tariff setting.
36050.j: The memorandum justifies the delegated and new powers by the particular circumstances of Caribbean Netherlands and the constitutional allowance for differentiated policy in Article 132a of the Constitution.
q: Moreover, Chapter 5 of the Wedb already provides that subsidies can be granted to a distributor to lower tariffs for consumers.
Bovendien is in Hoofdstuk 5 van de Wedb al geregeld dat er subsidies verleend kunnen worden aan een distributeur om de tarieven voor afnemers te kunnen verlagen.
d: Artikel I, E (art. 3.13, derde lid Wedb)
designation of installations subject to water quality requirements
Artikel I, L (art. 6.12, vijfde lid Wedb)
minister's measures in exceptional circumstances to safeguard drinking water supply
designation of packaging for drinking water subject to the Wedb
Artikel II, B (art. 4.25, derde lid WVROM BES)
island council wastewater ordinance designating areas and rules on offering wastewater
p: Artikel I, L (art. 6.12, vijfde lid Wedb)
Minister may take measures he deems reasonably necessary in exceptional circumstances to safeguard public drinking water supply, after consultation where possible, with no tariff effect.
Artikel I, B and Artikel IV (Warenwet BES exclusion)
Packaged drinking water in designated packaging falls under the Wedb instead of the Warenwet BES, shifting the regulatory regime through ministerial designation.

parties: Asks which measures the Minister can take in extraordinary circumstances, why adequate instruments are currently lacking, and when they will be available.
These members note that this responsibility rests with the Minister, but that he currently does not have adequate instruments to actually take these measures.
Deze leden constateren dat deze verantwoordelijkheid berust bij de Minister, maar dat hij momenteel niet beschikt over afdoende instrumenten om deze maatregelen daadwerkelijk te treffen.
Asks how the Saba tariff framework keeps the three tariff goals and how the cost burden of the Bonaire wastewater charge is distributed so that the strongest shoulders bear it.
These members want to stress that the most important thing is that the major polluter pays and that cost distribution happens in such a way that the strongest shoulders bear the heaviest burdens.
Deze leden willen benadrukken dat het belangrijkste is dat de grote vervuiler hierbij betaalt en dat de kostenverdeling op zodanige wijze gebeurt dat de sterkste schouders de zwaarste lasten dragen.
Questions whether the government grasps the consequences of removing the emergency drinking-water reserve obligation and rejects the Raad van State advice not being followed.

These members ask whether the government realises that this concerns an emergency drinking-water supply and that removing this obligation may have major consequences for maintaining the emergency water supply.

Deze leden vragen of de regering beseft dat het hier over een noodvoorziening van drinkwater gaat en dat het schrappen van deze verplichting grote gevolgen kan hebben voor de instandhouding van de noodwatervoorziening.
Asks for status updates on the financial sustainability study, the Bonaire financing alternatives, and the consultation referred to in the memorandum.
Which consultation does the explanatory memorandum refer to, which was not sent along but only made available for inspection at the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives?
Naar welke consultatie verwijst de memorie, die niet is meegestuurd maar uitsluitend ter inzage gelegd bij het Centraal Informatiepunt van de Tweede Kamer?
Asks why the drinking-water reserve obligation is removed and worries about affordability of living on Bonaire after the wastewater charge.
The ChristenUnie members are concerned about the affordability of living costs on Bonaire after the introduction of the wastewater charge.
De leden van de ChristenUnie-fractie maken zich zorgen over de betaalbaarheid van het levensonderhoud op Bonaire na invoering van de afvalwaterheffing.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advises on a bill amending Caribbean Netherlands drinking water and wastewater rules, raising remarks on replacing the seven-day drinking water reserve with an unspecified emergency supply and on the absence of tariff regulation for Saba. The minister's reply largely rejects the requested tariff motivation and specification but adopts the proposed redrafting of the emergency supply duty and a redactional amendment.
concerns: The Afdeling asks that the bill specify the number of days the emergency supply must bridge outages, which the government did not add, arguing ILT guidance and the capacity document suffice.

The Afdeling asks for a reasoned justification for abandoning tariff regulation on Saba or, failing that, a tariff regime adapted to Saba, which the government rejects, relying on OLS, VEI cost-based tariffs and subsidy.
The Afdeling's redactional remark on article IM (inserting 'na die datum' in article 7.4) was adopted in the amended bill.

36131.s: The bill gives the Financieel Stabiliteitscomité a statutory basis in the Bankwet 1998 and makes a series of technical amendments across financial supervision, pensions, insolvency, auditing and civil law. Among these, it broadens the definition of credit fees in the Wft BES, introduces a notification duty and supervisory consent for intra-group changes in qualifying holdings, and restricts curator liability to intentional or grossly negligent misconduct.
36131.j: The memorandum justifies the notification and consent regime by reference to the European directives and ESA guidelines, which require proportionate supervisory assessment of intra-group changes.
q: Given the obligation arising from these directives, an amendment is necessary.
Gelet op de verplichting die daartoe voortvloeit uit genoemde richtlijnen, is een wijziging noodzakelijk.
d: own risk and solvency reporting for small insurers
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel K (artikel 3:103a, zesde lid Wft)
information to be provided with intra-group change notification
ARTIKEL I, onderdeel D (artikel 2:3e, vijfde en zesde lid Wft)
technical regulatory standards adopted by EBA under the payment services directive
p: Supervisory consent is required for intra-group changes in qualifying holdings, with a deemed-consent rule and a proportionality principle limiting the scope of review.
Statutory basis for periodic financial stability consultation between DNB, AFM and the Minister, with reports to both chambers of parliament.
ARTIKEL IV, V, VI (artikel 172 Pw, 167 Wvb, 54 Wtt 2018)
Curators appointed by DNB are exempt from liability except for intentional misconduct or gross negligence, reducing private redress against a state-appointed actor.

parties: Welcomes the government's explanation and has no further questions on the amendment bill.
These members thank the government for the explanation and have no further questions about the amendment act.
Deze leden danken de regering voor de toelichting en hebben geen verdere vragen bij de Wijzigingswet.

Asks what legal status the FSC will have, how its advice relates to that of member bodies, and how dissent is weighed to avoid groupthink, citing Council of State concerns about blurred responsibilities.
The Council of State's advisory division also expressed concern about blurring of responsibilities due to introducing the FSC in the law, which D66 members partly share.

De afdeling advisering van de Raad van State heeft ook zorgen geuit over vertroebeling van verantwoordelijkheden als gevolg van de introductie van het FSC in de wet, die deels worden gedeeld door de leden van de D66-fractie.
Welcomes the changes made after the Council of State's critical advice but asks how parliament can exercise control over the committee and follow up its insights.
The CDA members ask how the government can indicate that parliament's supervisory role over this committee's work is guaranteed, as well as follow-up on insights that can strengthen the system.

De leden van de CDA-fractie vragen of de regering kan aangeven hoe het kunnen vervullen van de controlerende taak op de werkzaamheden van dit comité enerzijds, maar ook de opvolging van inzichten die ons stelsel kunnen versterken en beschermen anderzijds door het parlement, gewaarborgd wordt.
Supports the statutory anchoring of the FSC and asks why it was only now implemented despite IMF advice from 2017.
These members ask the government to explain why this statutory anchoring is only now being implemented, although the IMF called on the Netherlands to do so as early as 2017.
Deze leden vragen de regering om toe te lichten waarom deze wettelijke verankering pas nu wordt doorgevoerd, terwijl het Internationaal Monetair Fonds (IMF) Nederland hier al in 2017 toe opriep.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised in September 2020 against submitting the Wijzigingswet financiële markten 2021 without revision, objecting mainly to the institutional design of the Financial Stability Committee (FSC) and to the unassessed effects of the redefined credit cost in the BES islands. The minister's reply of June 2022 adopts a revised FSC design as a consultation under DNB's responsibility, drops the 'comply or explain' rule and the CPB as participant, and supplements the BES credit cost analysis.
concerns: The FSC's blurred allocation of responsibilities between the Minister of Finance and DNB/AFM was objected to, and the government restructured the FSC as a legal consultation under DNB's responsibility.

The unclear legal status of the FSC and its lack of statutory tasks or powers was criticised; the government redesigned it rather than constituting a new body, though the 'comply or explain' rule was not adopted.
The Afdeling advised placing the FSC in the Wft instead of the Bankwet 1998, and the government moved the provision and added the AFM's participation to the Wft.
The effect of the broader definition of credit cost on credit supply and consumers in the BES islands was not assessed, and the memorie van toelichting was supplemented accordingly.

36140.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (fourth supplementary budget) to fund restitution to box 3 taxpayers and a guarantee for LNG terminal cancellation costs. It sets budget amounts in thousands of euros and takes effect from 1 July 2022, with retroactive effect if published later.
q: The budget statement of the Ministry of Finance for the year 2022 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën voor het jaar 2022 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36200-V.s: This bill sets the 2023 departmental budget for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs at a total of approximately EUR 12.88 billion in commitments and EUR 13.01 billion in expenditure, with receipts of EUR 2.79 billion, in thousands of euros. It enters into force on 1 January 2023 and is accompanied by an explanatory memorandum on policy priorities, including international legal order, EU contributions and information security.
q: The departmental budget statement for the year 2023 belonging to this law is established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2023 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering made no remarks on the draft 2023 budget law for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and advised submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes that some budgets require amendments, which are attached in annexes.

36203.s: The bill recalculates the taxable return from savings and investments (box 3) for tax years 2017 to 2022 after the Supreme Court's 24 December 2021 ruling, using fixed percentages per asset class set by the Minister of Finance for 2022 via ministerial regulation. It also adjusts related rules on joint partner deductions and double-taxation relief.
36203.j: The memorandum explains that the 2022 percentages are delegated so they can be set on the basis of published De Nederlandsche Bank interest data after the year ends.
q: After the end of calendar year 2022, within two months, the percentage listed in article 3, third paragraph, column I, last line, is replaced by ministerial regulation with another percentage.
Na afloop van het kalenderjaar 2022 wordt binnen twee maanden het in artikel 3, derde lid, kolom I, laatste regel, vermelde percentage bij ministeriële regeling vervangen door een ander percentage.
d: fixed 2022 return percentages for bank balances and debts

parties: Asks whether placing risk-averse bond holders in the same category as higher-returning assets is legally defensible given recent market losses.
Does the government consider the percentages for 'Other assets (II)', in light of the Kerstarrest, legally defensible given that share prices have generally fallen sharply, at least in 2022?

Acht de regering de percentages «Overige bezittingen (II)», mede in het licht van het Kerstarrest van de Hoge Raad, (juridisch) houdbaar gelet op het feit dat, in ieder geval in 2022, de aandelenkoersen in het algemeen fors zijn gedaald?
Asks about legal risks of narrow eligibility, partner allocation, and whether the new forfait system meets proportionality requirements.
These members ask the government to substantiate this.
Deze leden vragen de regering om dit te onderbouwen.
Questions the legal tenability of refusing ambtshalve vermindering and of excluding non-objectors, and asks for the Landsadvocaat advice to be shared.
These members ask whether the government will share this draft Landsadvocaat advice on providing legal redress to non-objectors with the House.
Deze leden vragen of de regering dit (concept) advies van de Landsadvocaat over het bieden van rechtsherstel aan niet-bezwaarmakers met de Kamer wil delen.
Argues that treating equal cases unequally undermines trust, is legally questionable, and will generate more procedures.
That the government chooses to treat equal cases unequally does not reflect well on politics in the eyes of these members.
Dat de regering ervoor kiest om gelijke gevallen ongelijk te behandelen, komt het beeld over de politiek in de ogen van deze leden niet ten goede.
Finds the eligibility limit to objectors unfair to silent citizens and asks whether it rewards the most vocal.
