Does the government consider it desirable that citizens who best stand up for themselves and are most outspoken are rewarded, while quiet citizens are left out?
Vindt de regering het wenselijk dat de burgers die het best voor zichzelf opkomen en het meest mondig zijn daarvoor beloond worden, terwijl de stille burgers buiten de boot vallen?
Asks how non-objectors' request for ambtshalve vermindering will be handled and what legal remedies they have if refused, and about improving the mass objection procedure.
What legal options does a non-objector have if the request for ambtshalve vermindering is not granted by the Belastingdienst?
Welke juridische mogelijkheden heeft een niet-bezwaarmaker als het verzoek om ambtshalve vermindering niet wordt gehonoreerd door de Belastingdienst?
Questions whether the averaged forfait for other assets and the choice of long-term returns are consistent with the Kerstarrest and whether new lawsuits are expected.
Is this in line with the ruling of 24 December 2021 (Kerstarrest)? Does the government expect new lawsuits on this point?
Is dit in lijn met het arrest van 24 december 2021 (Kerstarrest)? Verwacht de regering op dit punt nieuwe rechtszaken?
Asks whether differential treatment creates legal inequality and how many new objection or reduction requests are expected.
Can the government tell the PVV members whether providing redress to certain taxpayers leads to legal inequality or unequal treatment of taxpayers?

Kan de regering aan de leden van de PVV-fractie aangeven of het bieden van rechtsherstel aan belastingplichtigen ... leidt tot rechtsongelijkheid of dan wel verschil in behandeling van belastingplichtigen?

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the Wet rechtsherstel box 3, a bill codifying a generic, automated remedy for the box 3 wealth tax after the Hoge Raad's Kerstarrest of 24 December 2021, raising questions about the forfaitair treatment of overige bezittingen and debts and urging explanation of early implementation experience. The government's nader rapport added motivation for the forfaits and reported on implementation so far, and it incorporated the advised editorial and explanatory changes.
concerns: The Afdeling asked for a fuller justification of applying a forfaitair composition to the overige bezittingen category instead of the actual composition, and the government added that justification to the explanatory memorandum.

The Afdeling asked why only bank mortgage interest is used as the debt yield rather than including consumer credit with higher rates, and the government added explanation that the data do not allow finer distinctions.

The Afdeling asked that the explanatory memorandum address the implementation experience since the remedy began on 1 July 2022, and the government added details on letters, assessments and objection volumes.
The Afdeling's editorial remark on footnote 8 of the Overbruggingswet box 3 was adopted by inserting the passage on green savings and investments into the explanatory memorandum.
The Afdeling asked that information promised for Prinsjesdag on the group of non-objectors for whom the assessment is final be taken into account, a point the reply does not explicitly address.

36212.s: The bill unifies the multiple versions of several Civil Procedure Code articles into one, mainly modernising and digitising cassation (Supreme Court) procedure, including electronic filing, summons and deadlines. It also amends the court fee act, Civil Code provisions on guardianship, trusteeship, shares, erfpacht, contract modification and carriage liability, and several related procedural statutes.
36212.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as simplification and digitisation of civil procedure, reflecting consultation with the Supreme Court and professional bodies, and gives no detailed justification for the ministerial delegations.
q: It is proposed to bring together all requirements for the summons, including those in other articles of the Supreme Court version of Rv, in a separate statutory article.
Voorgesteld wordt om alle eisen aan het oproepingsbericht, ook die in de versie Rv voor de Hoge Raad in andere artikelen staan, bij elkaar te zetten en in een apart wetsartikel op te nemen
d: form and content of summons (oproepingsbericht) and service rules
electronic signature requirements set by general administrative order (AMvB)
Artikel IV, onderdeel E (Artikel 4, derde lid)
categories of cases exempt from court fees by ministerial regulation
Artikel IV, onderdeel I (Artikel 21, tweede lid)
fees for copies and extracts of judgments set by general administrative order
p: Artikel IV, onderdeel E (Artikel 4, derde lid)
The minister may by regulation designate further categories of cases in which no court fee is levied, shifting access rules to ministerial discretion without parliamentary input.

parties: Supports the bill as simplifying civil procedure, but asks whether the Experimentenwet rechtspleging should be amended too and what happens to procedures started before entry into force, including the absence of transitional provisions.
Therefore it is good for legal practice that after the bill takes effect there will be only one version of the Code of Civil Procedure.
Daarom is het goed voor de rechtspraktijk dat er na inwerkingtreding van het wetsvoorstel nog maar één versie is van het Wetboek van Burgerlijke rechtsvordering.
Thanks the government and has no further questions.
Welcomes the clarity created by merging the two versions and has no questions on the proposal.
They welcome the clarity created by merging both versions.
Zij verwelkomen de duidelijkheid die wordt geschept met het samenvoegen van beide versies.

Notes the bill is only a technical adjustment since digitalisation and simplification of civil procedure failed, and asks whether a renewed attempt is expected and what lessons were learned about implementation problems.
These members note that this is only a technical adjustment since the digitalisation and simplification of civil procedure has not succeeded.
Deze leden constateren dat het om slechts een technische aanpassing gaat nu de digitalisering en vereenvoudiging van het civiele procesrecht niet geslaagd is.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on the bill for the technical unification of the Wetboek van Burgerlijke Rechtsvordering and made no remarks, advising that it be submitted to the Tweede Kamer. The government's nader rapport notes the bill was amended to add a previously omitted law with re-enacted articles in the correct terminology, with no substantive change.

36302.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to increase the Dutch contribution to the European Peace Facility by about 137 million euro via a supplementary budget. It sets the budget unit in thousands of euro and makes the change effective from 1 March 2023 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for the year 2023
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken (V) voor het jaar 2023

36311.s: The bill simplifies the Dutch rent allowance (huurtoeslag) by removing the maximum rent limit as a condition for receiving the allowance, lowering the youth age threshold from 23 to 21, and dropping the option to count service costs in the rent. It also makes related technical amendments to the Wet op de huurtoeslag and sets the commencement date by royal decree.
36311.j: The memorandum justifies the changes as simplifying implementation and reducing checks and corrections by Toeslagen, without new executive powers being claimed.
q: This all-or-nothing criterion leads in practice to discussions about limits and is a burden for implementation.
Dit alles-of-niets criterium leidt in de praktijk tot grensdiscussies en is een belasting voor de uitvoering.
d: commencement date of the law by royal decree

parties: Welcomes broader eligibility and youth age reduction; has no further questions.
Supports simplification but questions why young people with disabilities must still actively apply, and raises concerns about service cost effects on elderly and disabled.
These members wonder whether it is desirable that young people with a disability in particular have an exceptional position and must take extra steps themselves.](Verified)
Deze leden vragen zich af of het wenselijk is dat juist jongeren met een handicap een uitzonderingspositie hebben en zelf extra stappen moeten zetten.

Notes many recipients lose financially, asks how the government will reduce the share of new recipients above the affordability benchmark and help those losing out, and flags high recovery and repayment rates.
These members would have preferred otherwise.
Deze leden hadden dit liever anders gezien.
Asks for cost estimates for the treasury of removing the maximum rent cap and extending allowance to non-self-contained housing and to service cost abolition.
Worries that abolishing service-cost subsidy makes tenants dependent on landlords who may use service charges to raise income, and asks how excessive side effects will be prevented.
These members want to know whether the government has insight into what this does to the financial position of tenants.
Deze leden willen weten of de regering zicht heeft op wat dit doet met de financiële positie van huurders.
Opposes ending service-cost inclusion and the 4 euro co-payment increase, arguing financially vulnerable tenants bear the costs of the expansion, and requests detailed impact figures.
Supports reform aims but questions why only disabled youth must actively apply, the impact on residents of apartment complexes with service costs, and whether the Nibud should re-assess.
It therefore surprises them that only young people with a disability must still themselves indicate that they qualify for a rent allowance calculation.
Het bevreemdt hen daarom dat alleen jongeren met een handicap zelf nog moeten zullen aangeven dat zij in aanmerking komen voor een huurtoeslagberekening.
Asks about the government's future vision for the rent allowance and whether norm rents are being dropped as agreed in the coalition agreement.
These members ask about the government's vision of the future of the rent allowance.
Deze leden vragen naar de visie van de regering over de toekomst van de huurtoeslag.

v.summary: The Raad van State advisory division advised against proceeding with the bill reforming the rent allowance (huurtoeslag), citing serious concerns about the normalised-rent model, negative income effects for about two-thirds of recipients, and implementability for the Dienst Toeslagen. The minister's reply removes the normalised-rent component, keeps the remaining simplification measures, and adapts the bill and explanatory memorandum accordingly.
concerns: The Afdeling objected that the normalised rent of EUR 520 was set for budget neutrality rather than on a reasoned basis, with large negative income effects; the government dropped the normalised-rent component.

The Afdeling found the implementation test showed serious risks for the Dienst Toeslagen from running two systems in parallel; the government says a new implementation test on the remaining measures shows no major risks.
The Afdeling said it was unclear how the bill fits a future reform of the entire toeslagen system; the government answered that the remaining measures are standalone short-term simplifications.
The Afdeling noted that terugvorderingen can be severe and affect trust in government, and that the bill does not significantly reduce them.

36401.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the Ministry of Interior and Kingdom Relations by an incidental supplementary budget to refinance COVID loans, with an effective date retroactive to 29 August 2023. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and consists of a budget table with adjustments to several articles.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of Kingdom Relations for the year 2023
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties voor het jaar 2023

36410-IIA.s: This bill adopts the 2024 budget statement of the States General (Staten-Generaal, budget IIA), setting the expenditure and revenue ceilings for the Eerste Kamer, Tweede Kamer and joint parliamentary activities in thousands of euros. The accompanying explanatory memorandum describes the budget articles and their financial effects, without delegating rule-making power or shifting power away from checks.
q: Article 1 The budget statement attached to this law for the year 2024 is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an advisory opinion on the 2024 budget bill (begrotingsstaten) for the States General and related budget chapters, raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance transmitted the opinion together with the advisory letters for all ministries and funds, with no substantive government reply needed.

36435-L.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the Nationaal Groeifonds (National Growth Fund) ministry, reducing commitments and expenditure by 10,000 thousand euros under the research and development article. The explanatory memorandum shows no change to the knowledge development article and notes that remaining funds were carried forward to later years.
q: All funds remaining for 2023 have been carried forward to later years on the basis of the 100% year-end margin.
Alle voor 2023 resterende middelen zijn doorgeschoven naar latere jaren op basis van de 100%-eindejaarsmarge.

36625-K.s: This bill amends the 2024 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K), with a second supplementary budget adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts in thousands of euros. It sets the amendment to take effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactively from 1 December 2024.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for the year 2024
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) voor het jaar 2024

36725-J.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statement of the Delta Fund (Deltafonds) through a first supplementary budget, reallocating commitments, expenditures and receipts across articles on flood safety, freshwater supply, maintenance, experiments and water quality. It also shifts extra funds for water quality and backdates the amendment to 1 June 2025.
36725-J.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes as transfers of available funds to the articles where they are needed for maintaining dikes, dunes and dams, with no delegation or new powers claimed.
q: With these changes, the funds made available are transferred to the articles where they will be used to maintain our dikes, dunes and dams.
Met deze mutaties worden de beschikbaar gestelde middelen overgeboekt naar de artikelen waar ze worden ingezet voor de instandhouding van onze dijken, duinen en dammen.

36850-K.s: This bill amends the 2025 departmental budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) by adjusting commitments, expenditure and revenue across the materiel and infrastructure items. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 1 December 2025.
q: The budget statement of the Defence Materiel Budget Fund (K) for 2025 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het Defensiematerieelbegrotingsfonds (K) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36850-XXIII.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (second supplementary budget), mainly reducing energy subsidy and project appropriations within article 31 and adjusting the Nederlandse Emissieautoriteit agency budget. It does not delegate rule-making power, shift powers, or create emergency or oversight changes.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (XXIII) for the year 2025 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (XXIII) voor het jaar 2025 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36915-I.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2026 budget of the Crown (Koning), raising its expenditure and commitments by about EUR 679 thousand, mainly through the carry-over of the 2025 year-end margin. The bill itself contains no delegation of rule-making power and no shift of power away from checks.
q: Carry-over of the 2025 year-end margin as it took place at the Cabinet of the King within the Ministry of General Affairs.
Doorbelasting van de eindejaarsmarge 2025 zoals deze bij het Kabinet van de Koning als onderdeel van het Ministerie van AZ heeft plaatsgevonden.
